name: Geosite
long_description:
**GENERAL**
Geosite is an enterprise SaaS platform for spatial data. Through pairing a marketplace with integrated data management and collaboration tools, Geosite enables customers to leverage spatial data for more rapid and accurate planning and operations. This platform is a dual use technology for both commercial and military customers.

//

**SPACE PEOPLE**
Geosite is a cloud-based platform creating a comprehensive repository of geospatial data, such as satellite imagery, through the aggregation of public and commercially available data, providing market-wide ability to rapidly search, select, purchase, assemble, and manage data sets. This will not only create the most comprehensive and exhaustive marketplace for geospatial data and analytics, but also build the underlying data infrastructure for the geospatial industry. This marketplace, for both analytics and data, will enable customers from Oil and Gas companies to US Special Operations to access and consume data from many sources for greater operational efficiency and safety. 

//

**O&G PEOPLE**
Geosite is a data platform for Oil and Gas companies that allows customers to bring together their data for a clearer picture of the world. Over 80% of information has a spatial component to it, rarely is this being leveraged to add to the bottom line for Oil and Gas companies. With the proliferation of satellites and distributed sensors (IOT), we are at a juncture of immense opportunity for Oil and Gas exploration to reach an operational efficiency that was impossible only a few years ago. Geosite allows for cutting edge logistics planning and operational tracking to increase safety and productivity.
one_liner: Geosite is an enterprise SaaS platform for spatial data.

name: Vendr
long_description: Vendr built the AI negotiation agent that helps companies stop overpaying for software by using real contract data to benchmark prices and secure better deals automatically.
one_liner: The AI negotiation agent to help you save money on SaaS.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: Vendr was founded in 2018 to make software buying fast, fair, and transparent. After joining Y Combinator in 2019, founder and CEO Ryan Neu built Vendr to help companies save money on SaaS through data-driven negotiations. Following its $150M Series B, Vendr evolved from a services-led business into an AI-first company, launching Ruth—the negotiation agent trained on the world’s largest dataset of SaaS pricing and negotiation insights—to help every buyer get a fair deal automatically.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Software sales is broken. Buying SaaS still feels manual, slow, and opaque—buyers don’t know what a fair price is, and sellers spend months negotiating instead of closing deals. After leading SMB sales at HubSpot through its IPO, Ryan saw firsthand how inefficient the process had become. In 2018, he founded Vendr to fix it. Today, Vendr’s AI negotiation agent, Ruth, uses real pricing and contract data to help buyers get fair deals instantly—turning a once painful process into a transparent, data-driven transaction.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our long-term vision is to fix software sales by making every transaction data-driven and fair. If we succeed, no one will overpay for software again. Buyers will use AI agents like Ruth to get transparent, market-based prices instantly—and sellers will close deals faster with trust built in. Software buying will finally be as efficient and predictable as any other modern transaction.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Ryan Neu is the founder and CEO of Vendr, creator of Ruth—the AI negotiation agent that helps companies save money on software using real pricing and contract data. Before founding Vendr, Ryan led SMB sales at HubSpot from its early days through IPO. Try Ruth for free at agent.vendr.com.

launches.tagline: Welcome helps marketing teams create content through webinars
launches.body:
TLDR: Webinars are one of the most effective ways to get leads. Welcome focuses on creating webinars that drive engagement and revenue.

**The Problem**

Webinars can often be stodgy and un-engaging. Existing tools like On24, Zoom Webinar or GotoWebinar are focused more on registration and analytics than the live experience. As a result, webinar attendees are often left bored.

**The Solution**

Welcome is a webinar platform with a built in content creation studio. This mean you can add music, videos and useful on-screen overlays to complement your webinar. For example, here is a new feature we recently released that allows you to put on-screen calls to action for your attendees.

**Interested in trying it out?**

Fill out our [demo request](https://www.experiencewelcome.com/demo) form if you or your marketing team would like a live demo.

We also just launched a YC deal for 50% off our base package.

launches.title: Agent Intro — Automate ongoing state compliance, free of charge
launches.tagline: Monitor compliance, file reports, and register for payroll — all in one platform
launches.body:
A year and a half ago, we launched [Firstbase Agent](https://www.firstbase.io/agent) —  our all-in-one state compliance solution for startups. You appoint Firstbase as your registered agent in every state where you operate or have employees, and we receive and view notices from the government, give you reminders about compliance events, and monitor your compliance status in each state, file annual reports, BOI reports, and franchise taxes. We will also help you register and maintain your payroll accounts in any state where you want to hire any employee — this way, you can avoid paying extremely high EOR fees (often around \~$700/employee/month) and instead hire an employee through your own entity. And, of course, we help you fulfill the legal obligation of having a registered agent in every state where you operate. \
\
One huge difference between us and other state compliance providers is that we actually own and operate our own entities in all 50 states as a licensed commercial registered agent. So we have direct contact with the state and don’t have to rely on any third parties for anything.

Why it’s important: to give an example, if you hire an employee in a new state and need payroll accounts, your payroll tax registration partner will typically work with a network of registered agents in different states and won’t really have control over anything. They’ll often need that third party to sign off on forms, which slows things down and often leads to operational nightmares.

Now, almost 15,000 companies are using Firstbase Agent, and we have decided to do something nice and give part of the functionality **_free of charge_**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79631&key=user_uploads/604873/0ace0f6e-0c19-40fb-8a7c-5df9da57e478)

\
Meet [**_Firstbase Agent Intro_**](https://firstbase.io/agent-intro?utm_source=bookface&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=bookface_V1) — the simplest way to manage state compliance. We’d love to get your feedback. And again, it’s free.

Agent Intro is designed for founders who currently manage their business compliance outside of the Firstbase platform, and use a different commercial registered agent. Agent Intro includes three awesome features:

1. 📁 **Initial beneficial ownership information (BOI) filing**: The U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network requires all companies to file this on an ongoing basis, and we’ll take care of it for you!
2. 2\. 🚥 **Firstbase command center**: Get an instant overview of your compliance status in every state where your business operates.
3. 3\. ✅ **State compliance reminders**: We’ll track your deadlines and let you know about any required actions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79631&key=user_uploads/604873/860e4f94-e0f4-46a7-9185-6d84d5748c93)

No more scrolling through different state websites to find due dates — we make it easy to track everything in one place.

We’ll be launching Agent Intro soon, and we would love to see you among its first users! Just visit the link below and join the waitlist to guarantee your spot.

Much love [❤️](https://emojipedia.org/red-heart)

[https://firstbase.io/agent-intro?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=bookface_V1](https://firstbase.io/agent-intro?utm_source=bookface&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=bookface_V1)

launches.title: Firstbase Agent – Payroll Tax Registration & Ongoing Compliance for startups
launches.tagline: Compliance-in-the-box for scaling companies: automate annual reports, franchise tax filings, payroll tax registrations, and get help with federal tax filings.
launches.body:
Hi YC! I’m so excited to announce the launch of our new product.\
\
Firstbase Agent handles your company's ongoing compliance in every state, so you can focus on scaling.\
\
_We are launching with three new plans:_\
\
**Agent Light ($99/year)** – appoint Firstbase as your registered agent in every state where you operate, receive and view notices from the government, and get reminders about compliance events, such as annual reports, franchise tax filings, and more. It’s a better, more automated registered agent product for growing startups. \
\
Need more that just reminders? Meet Agent Autopilot and Agent Payroll!\
\
**Agent Autopilot ($299/year)** – get everything from Agent Light + put all ongoing filings on autopilot. Firstbase will generate and file your annual reports, franchise tax reports, and more.

![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/VG5iPduzy864stPMJaqgDAFkNPbEAUNMXmLIvcw_oBeqEe-TEDLAm04J8EXHX_KtvPNYHYXKZAxg6XkKl483opBm8PNtjkwydVy2qkxU2tcJqN9VVZdvVRxuCiMfOoZMDi9VPzmmN0ZEhjmI94bzmek_E56inCPYm3tdEiJUwW4gJht5CQPhFPE2JJP2tA)

\
_Special offer for foreign founders_: if you purchase Autopilot, and appoint us as your Agent in the state of incorporation, you will get access to a self-service tool for forms 5472 & pro-forma Form 1120 for FREE! So if you are a foreign-owned US entity with filing obligations in the US, you will be able to file it directly from your Firstbase dashboard!\
\
\
**Agent Payroll ($599/year)** – register for payroll in any of the 50 states to hire employees compliantly. Get payroll account numbers. Put ongoing compliance – and all filings – in each of those states on autopilot.  \
\
Agent Payroll also includes a feature called Track (launching in Q1 2023) – we will retrieve all notices, balances and more, directly from your online accounts with each of the states and display them in your Firstbase dashboard.

![](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/-mlHwHmVUjf-zPkgmJvAitqhht6by0e3P13BPWYzel5zS0g7pUy47fLJcfJ7ncexagzFJ5EKyxd4QCTCj4Bxw8re1eGZSj8kpqf4ziAUrEbJ-3RbqSdYyI41gjXdoqAUC-qe1anJ0IMB2sY3OSsSqLiBdH5gtdyr7CQX4CqQaIZT-2goD_GHy5hY9FXXVg)

\
\
Sign up as an existing business here: <https://www.firstbase.io/agent> or use Firstbase Start to launch a new company:)\
\
Also email me with any questions: [mark@firstbase.io](mailto:mark@firstbase.io)\
\
_PS Each plan will require you to appoint us as your registered agent so we can process filings on your behalf, take care of your compliance, and give you access to all features. If you already appointed someone as your registered agent in one of the states where you are purchasing Agent, we will take care of the change-of-agent paperwork during onboarding, free of charge._

launches.title: FirstSupport - AI assistant for Customer Support 🚀
launches.tagline: FirstSupport gives customer support teams superpowers by automating translation, information retrieval, insights reports, tagging, and more.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**\
FirstSupport grants superpowers to customer support teams by automating translation, information retrieval, generating brand-aligned responses, summarizing conversations, generating insightful reports, and automating tagging.\
\
One week following our launch on Zendesk Marketplace, our product has been used by e-commerce merchants using platforms like _Magento/Woocommerce/Shopify_, customer support outsourcing firms, and startups across Asia, Europe, and America. These companies serve customers from multiple countries who speak different languages, and they manage extensive knowledge bases.\
—

---

### Introducing, the Five “Superpowers”

1- **Instant Response Drafting**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76629&key=user_uploads/376547/c2baeb66-ae16-4028-91bf-26aa6171e6cd)

Whenever your customer support team opens a ticket, FirstSupport AI will automatically generate a response draft based on

* Information on your knowledge resource (Zendesk Knowledge Base, Google Docs, PDF, Website, Sitemap, Past Ticket Conversations, and more) that you can connect in our dashboard
* Information from the connected third-party platform (Shopify/Stripe/Woocommerce), or custom APIs such as your internal tool
* Brand personality guideline for your company

So you can review and submit directly in one click. See how it works:

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=76629&key=user_uploads/376547/47643cc9-4c86-4d61-a2e9-11dcf6c97122)

2- **Seamless AI-powered Translation**

Enhance your global or multi-lingual customer support with FirstSupport.

* Automatically detect the customer's language and translate the entire conversation into your preferred language
* Write in your language and have it automatically translated into the customer's language

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/OVu1JRK7bP1Q-ojr53aC0TN13ofKr7PYPssKtMx9xx3hp1lzktWh_i-ICqSHT7yW3Hd_UEp0ieafsf-NbgQXcnOG2RMBQ-ylnXTaePUh4m1EFRyx3EsHR35VqZ0jhgOmiDjDa8sQbW846bdEPy9iDEw)

3- **One-Click Ticket Summarization**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/bkk8U-MrHGO30smMpmzS3680rTihlgL2xjpLMCTsoz0N6dZ5K5gvlE1IMWzgyjHqs0ztQFf3HdmW2Q1XToCyOqI4py2NpcmiOsdxZJtz6akS3U3iJ5EELtbrymDesswYeJyZEcTxotpUcepX-CxDpzc)

Supervisors and L2 agents can quickly capture the essence of customer interactions with a simple click of the '**Summarize**' button.\
Our customizable summary formats enable the extraction of diverse data from each ticket, ranging from **product/customer information** to insights into **customer emotions** during the conversation, ensuring comprehensive and efficient overviews tailored to your specific business needs

See it in action:

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/X_yHCRD6i8gvzlQc8-nY85UH8oJ7PDg_DgM8mBL1Wr24InW5WH-Jsb5p-eomidHELzPtVnAcobB_D3JXe3Q4I8YE5z6vOHcJOphFGNOnKnXLwvBBRtPUR8azT8r2-SZAQ9XfqBsat2wnhHLlAS6B-X8)

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/i_NclnYzY0FBjZARKZ_Kp1LFPkG94wuGfSEENJQtygaeo-sdEd169bjVRAqzihuH60GZB2C9dV5WZXTG1INDaC5qiOJIF9R4L70lAf5ym1NCn0uKbhvCd6gLPjiu3RM6bnHwFuzisu0TK1-9_0OShZs)

4- **Automated Tagging**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/qkwM7qZeuVORv6IAwhqhwX--XnE29vam_WkOEzsqBe-fIvXCcU4xZEXxgpzTlCKH-3NTE-X3E4jdYF_7ngiiHvBqkJwY6PnRUxzPWkKdBpc-gL5t5aZKW442J96Mw9bkIAAYtb7bzdRnpx_8wgkGx4g)

Easily assign relevant tags to your tickets with just one click. Customize your Zendesk tags directly in our dashboard for streamlined ticket management.

5- **Insightful Report Generation**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76629&key=user_uploads/376547/2af89abb-f1e1-4f61-95db-3c6fddeac8b7)

FirstSupport AI analyzes each customer interaction and support ticket to identify common issues, knowledge gaps, and immediate action steps. Additionally, you'll receive an email summary with detailed highlights attached.

### **Try For Free (with exclusive support!)**

You can try our product by registering on our [web app](https://app.firstsupport.ai), or by installing it from [Zendesk Marketplace](https://www.zendesk.com/marketplace/apps/support/980970/firstsupport-ai-assistant/).\
\
We offer a **two-week free trial** and **personalized onboarding support** directly from our co-founders (reach out to us via [hi@firstsupport.ai](mailto:hi@firstsupport.ai) mentioning that you found us through the YC Launch)

### **Be Our Partner**

If you can refer us to:

* Customer support BPO (outsourcing) companies,
* E-commerce merchants using Zendesk,
* or, you’re just interested in being our sales partner

We would love to chat. Please reach out to our email [hi@firstsupport.ai](mailto:hi@firstsupport.ai)

—\
Contact us at [hi@firstsupport.ai](mailto:hi@firstsupport.ai) for any requests, questions, or feedback. Cheers!

launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Christina and Andrew, co-founders of [OneSchema](https://oneschema.co/). We’re very excited to share the launch of our new product line with you!

## **Founders Backstory**

As a product manager and engineering manager, we both suffered through months of wasted engineering time building CSV importers instead of core product features. Even after launch, the [maintenance never seemed to end](https://www.oneschema.co/blog/csv-importer-cost) - parsing issues, performance improvements, and UX issues always seemed to pop up. 

We decided to build OneSchema so product teams could focus on the features that matter most to their customers.

## **What is OneSchema?**

OneSchema is an embeddable CSV importer for SaaS companies. Product and engineering teams use OneSchema to save months of development and maintenance time and provide a best-in-class CSV import process for their customers. OneSchema cleans customer data during import, and offers helpful suggestions for resolving errors. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=66712&key=user_uploads/431865/e31cbb2a-a4c0-4455-9a51-593e136d5367)

Our product team is laser-focused on making data onboarding as fast and seamless as possible for your customers. We are a developer-first platform and have built OneSchema so you can have production-ready CSV import set up in less than a day.

## **We'd love to hear from you!**

We’re excited to help companies deliver a delightful onboarding experience for their users. If you’re interested in learning more, feel free to [book a demo here](https://demo.oneschema.co/?utm_source=yc&utm_campaign=launchboard) or reach out to us at [founders@oneschema.co](mailto:founders@oneschema.co)

launches.tagline: AI agents that turn every call into revenue for trade businesses
launches.body:
Hi All,

I’m excited to share [Spadeworks](http://www.spadeworks.co) with you all

## Problem

Trade contractors lose 40% of potential revenue because they can't answer calls while working on jobs. Every missed call is a missed customer - whether it's an emergency plumbing call at 9pm or a pest control inquiry during a busy day. Traditional solutions like call centers are expensive and don't understand trade-specific needs like emergency vs routine calls, seasonal pricing, or multi-visit treatment protocols.

## Insight

Trade contractors have predictable, repeatable customer interactions that follow industry-specific patterns. A pest control call about wasps needs immediate scheduling, while routine maintenance can wait. HVAC emergencies have different urgency than annual tune-ups. These conversations follow scripts that can be automated, but only if the AI understands trades terminology, pricing structures, and seasonal patterns.

## Solution

Spadeworks provides AI agents specifically trained for trade industries. Our AI answers calls, triages by urgency (emergency vs routine), schedules appointments based on technician availability and geographic routes, generates quotes using the contractor's pricing, sends SMS reminders, and handles follow-ups. When complex issues arise, it seamlessly transfers to humans with full context. The AI integrates with existing CRM and scheduling systems.

launches.title: Workflow86: AI that automates any workflow/business process in minutes
launches.tagline: Automate any workflow/business process by describing it in natural language
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Workflow86 is an AI workflow engineer that takes natural language descriptions of business processes and automatically creates fully configured automations with forms, tasks, AI, integrations, and more. 

https://www.loom.com/share/87e8ea3ad34b425dab8bdfaf31da7f1c?sid=27762eb9-43d8-44a5-8daf-5a1d6ce4e51f

# **The Problem**

Every business has mission-critical processes that eat up hours of manual work: employee onboarding, contract approvals, lead qualification, vendor management. You know automation could help, but it faces three major issues:

1. **Existing business systems are rigid,** and systems of record like CRMs and ERPs make customization frustrating, complex, and expensive, often requiring external consultants or their own dedicated developers 
2. **No-code tools still have a significant learning curve,** and teams still spend weeks figuring out how to configure and build custom workflows properly before they can deliver value
3. **Pure no-code solutions struggle to handle edge cases** or highly custom business logic, requiring complex and clunky workarounds.
4. **Existing tools struggle to fully capture real-world business processes,** which involve complex processes that require a mixture of automation and human-in-the-loop, involve multiple teams and stakeholders, and extend across days, weeks, or even months.

   

## **Our Solution**

Workflow86 is an AI workflow engineer that takes natural language descriptions of business processes and automatically creates fully configured automations with forms, tasks, AI steps, integrations, and more. 

### **Design and deploy automations in minutes**

This allows anyone to build and deploy custom business processes and workflow automations by chatting to their own on-demand workflow automation expert. 

1. **Describe your process** in natural language or even upload an image, flowchart, or process diagram
2. **AI asks clarifying questions** and develops an implementation plan just like a business analyst would
3. **AI builds and implements everything** using a combination of forms, human-in-the-loop tasks, database queries, AI steps, API integrations, and even custom JavaScript/Python code
4. **Deploy immediately** or iterate. You can manually edit the workflow yourself or with more AI assistance

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/594b669e-574d-4954-a739-3b809de40c01)

### **Combining the best of code and no-code, AI and human-in-the-loop**

Workflow86 goes beyond just connecting different apps together and builds end-to-end workflows with a range of nodes designed to handle the most complex real-workflow business processes and use cases. 

**Visually model complex business processes** and workflows end-to-end in one place via an intuitive visual flow interface with notes, descriptions, and AI explanations to keep everything up-to-date and easy to understand. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/86e66142-9d21-49b4-be71-e8fc1475c132)

**Run custom code** nodes to provide the power and flexibility of code to handle edge cases and complex, or highly customized steps. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/410c36be-1f4a-4668-aced-8181193ca9a8)

**Create AI-powered workflows** with AI nodes that use the latest LLMs to perform tasks inside of their workflow, including summarizing content, extracting values, searching the web, and more. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/ecf9b065-7f6a-4a7e-87b1-63eab31c1875)

**Built-in forms and human-in-the-loop** tasks keep everything in check for workflows requiring human review, approvals, and more. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/54f85e87-704b-4b49-bfda-3c58bb26755d)

**Integration nodes to seamlessly connect** to your existing systems and apps, allowing workflows to be triggered from your existing systems and apps (like your CRM, ticketing, email, and HR systems), and to trigger actions and events in these apps as well. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/755a1ce8-00c1-48e4-8881-a1f8fd60ef62)

### Use cases and examples

Here are some real-world examples you can try:

> Create an employee onboarding workflow that sends welcome emails, creates IT tickets for equipment, schedules meetings with the team, and tracks completion of training modules

> Build a contract approval process that routes based on contract value, requires legal review for contracts over $50k, collects digital signatures, and notifies stakeholders

> I need a lead scoring system that enriches leads from our website, scores them based on company size and engagement, assigns to sales reps by territory, and creates follow-up tasks

> Set up a customer refund process that validates the order, checks refund eligibility, gets manager approval for amounts over $500, processes the refund, and updates our CRM

> Create an expense approval workflow where employees submit receipts, AI categorizes expenses, routes to managers based on amount, and syncs approved expenses to QuickBooks

## Try it today

Visit[ workflow86.com](http://workflow86.com) to start for free. Type in a workflow or business process you want to automate and click generate to see our AI in action.

Have a complex workflow in mind? Book a demo and we'll build it with you live.

launches.title: Devyce - The business phone ☎️ in an app📱
launches.tagline: We give your employees work numbers on their personal phone instantly
launches.body:
We’re [Nick](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nick-browne-a8a829147/) and [Ed](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ed-clayton-1b8b7b27/), and we’re building [Devyce](https://devyce.com/?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch_yc&utm_id=launchyc&utm_content=top) - the business phone system for hybrid workers across the UK, Europe and worldwide. Want to get started with a UK mobile number right now? Download us from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/devyce/id1504660924) or [Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.devyce.client&hl=en&gl=UK) and sign up in-app

### The Problem 🚩 

Companies have three ways of getting phone calls to and from remote, hybrid, and offsite workers:

* They can give their employees a **costly second handset** 📱📱
* They can require that their employees use their **personal number for work** calls, hitting their privacy (and possibly regulatory requirements)🕵️
* They can persevere with a **legacy office phone system**, with the configuration difficulties and poor quality mobile apps that come with it 📟 - on top of a 50% typical missed call rate.

In all of these cases, companies struggle to understand user behaviour and performance, and they risk customer loss if an employee leaves.

### The Devyce Solution⚗️

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65611&key=user_uploads/982968/87c27f9a-1901-4c85-9f59-269aa9e01ba8)

Devyce customers use a portal to instantly allocate (and deallocate) numbers to employees, auto-attendants and call groups. They see calling stats and have the option to record calls and view a detailed call history.

* Our monthly charge of around **$20 per user** is significantly lower than the price of a second handset.🪙
* Users can be given **one or many mobile or landline numbers** instantly, from the UK, several European countries, and the US. 🌍
* Our product is designed for **mobile first**, and our apps get fantastic [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/devyce/id1504660924) and [Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.devyce.client&hl=en&gl=UK) reviews. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

### Our Magic Beans 🪄

Devyce has a close relationship with a UK mobile network operator. This not only gives us unbeatably low call costs (we’re paid to receive calls), but as we are expanding it lets us overcome regulatory issues in territories outside the UK.

launches.body:
# What We Do

TrueBiz verifies business identity by combining the processing of company documents, together with searches in best-in-class data sources.

# Who Has This Problem

Financial services companies onboarding business accounts often **revert to manual review because existing data sources can not provide a complete picture of the business.**

As a result, companies often rely on the business to provide supporting documentation — which is then manually reviewed. During the process they might review:

* An Articles of Incorporation to verify business identity
* A By Laws document to verify the shareholder structure
* An invoice to validate the nature of the business

The back and forth to capture the correct documents can go on for weeks. **This slows down onboarding and creates a frustrating customer experience.**

# How TrueBiz Solves KYB

TrueBiz validates the different documents required for each step of the verification process. This is combined with searches in best-in-class data sources. This range of tools enables our clients to convert more customers, with less effort.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64085&key=user_uploads/156422/f72085b1-1265-4782-8183-a68c792b9f90)

For our clients, this results in:

1. **Speed up time to activation:** we validate documents in seconds, preventing a slow back-and-forth to capture the correct paperwork. This shaves days off revenue realization.
2. **Reduce manual review:** we help identify the \~10% of cases that actually need further attention. You can redeploy the majority of your human analysts’ time and skill elsewhere.
3. **Scale:** we remove friction from the onboarding process, so you can grow faster.

Our process takes seconds – not days, so Financial Institutions can efficiently meet Know Your Business requirements and onboard new businesses faster.

# Book a demo

If you’re a fintech looking to optimize your business onboarding process, [schedule a demo here](https://calendly.com/dannyhak/truebiz-demo?month=2022-06).

launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re Deepak and Hakim. Before founding Fini (YC W22), we led product and growth teams at Uber, operating at the scale of 200 million+ support tickets every year. We founded Fini believing that AI support can (and should!) be held to a higher standard than human support.

**TL;DR** If you run support for a bank, fintech, insurance company, or any regulated industry, chances are you’ve tried your hand at generic AI support chatbots and realized they’re not a fit. A single hallucinated response can lead to lawsuits and PR disasters, destroying customer trust you’ve worked hard to build over decades. Fini AI was built specifically for these high-stakes environments, resolving 80% of support queries with full compliance and zero hallucinations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96968&key=user_uploads/1010279/fe000980-ba95-4470-9469-32c24fb5516a)


### **Support in regulated industries is broken**

Companies in finance, insurance, and healthcare face a brutal trade-off:

* **Scale support with humans:** Expensive, hard to hire, and training takes months.
* **Scale it with generic AI:** High risk of hallucinations, compliance breaches, and protocol violations.

In regulated spaces, hallucinations or protocol violations aren’t just isolated bad user experiences; it’s a potential regulatory fine. A class-action lawsuit. A PR disaster waiting to happen. Because of this, most teams are forced to stick with slow, expensive manual support, leaving customers waiting even for straightforward queries.

### **The (accuracy) problem**

If you lead a support team in a regulated industry, you can't just let an LLM loose on your knowledge base.

* Generic models prioritize "fluency" over "factuality."
* They often make up policies or promise refunds that don't exist.
* Audit trails are often non-existent or hard to parse.

You end up blind to what the AI is actually saying until it’s too late. This risk forces many companies to pull back on AI support entirely, leading to burnt-out agents and frustrated customers.

### **Fini solves this**

We built Fini to be accuracy-first. We monitor every interaction to ensure compliance and use specialized AI agents that don’t just "chat" — they solve.

* **98% Accuracy:** We hold our AI to even higher standards than human agents.
* **Human-in-the-Loop:** We seamlessly loop in human experts for edge cases.
* **Self-learning:** The AI learns from your best people whenever they intervene to solve a new problem.
* **Proven Scale:** We already resolve over 1 million tickets monthly for customers like the US Chamber of Commerce Foundation, Atlas, Found, and Bitdefender.

### **Our Asks**

* **Do you lead Support or CX** in a regulated industry (Fintech, Insurtech, Health) and want to automate tickets without the risk? **Let’s chat.**
* **Know a great operator?** We’re hiring a Head of Growth, Product Marketing Lead, and an AI Product Manager. Please introduce them to us!

Sanifu helps teams scale critical back-office processes without relying on brittle spreadsheets, scripts, or general AI tools that reinvent the logic every run.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9I1BvbW3n6Y>

### **The problem**

Analysts and teams in finance, revenue, and operations spend a huge part of their day doing manual data work. Cleaning data, preparing reports, moving things across systems, tracking work. It's repetitive, boring, and takes time away from the parts of their job that actually matter. The same work gets done repeatedly because their data is scattered across systems, emails, PDFs, and files. Only a few people know the rules and exceptions. When they leave, the process breaks.

Existing tools don't solve the whole problem. Spreadsheets, macros, and scripts are brittle and hard to maintain. General AI tools can help, but they reinvent the logic on every run, so outputs need constant checking and can't be trusted for critical workflows.

### **How Sanifu solves this**

Anyone can turn their manual data work into an autonomous data app—just by describing it.

1.⁠ ⁠You describe the process.

In plain English, you walk Sanifu through what you do. It asks the right questions, handles edge cases, understands your rules, and works with your real data (files, emails, systems) to define the full workflow.

2.⁠ ⁠Sanifu runs it with you.

It executes the process end-to-end, showing real-time progress and outputs. You review results, make changes, and refine the workflow until it matches exactly what you expect.

3.⁠ ⁠It becomes a reliable operations platform.

Once approved, Sanifu saves the entire process and turns it into a data app. All future runs replay the exact steps whereby the same input plus same context equals same output. It’s more than a workflow tool: built-in data stores, dashboards, forms, integrations, scheduled and event triggers as well as audit trails.

Sanifu is a full operational platform with 5k+ app integrations, 1k+ native components, forms, scheduler, data stores, dashboards, approvals, reviews, AI-powered entity matching among many  other features that make it an end-to-end data app management platform.

launches.body:
Hi YC!  👋

We’re Nathalie, Dalton, and Matt from Jasmine Energy.  Today we are proud to launch our latest AI tool to help solar owners claim their incentives.

The U.S. solar market is booming. It took 50 years to reach 5 million installations—now that number will double to 10 million in just six. 97% of these are on residential and commercial rooftops, yet over 1.7 million homes are missing out on valuable Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) income. Why? Because REC (Renewable Energy Certificate) management is still manual, confusing, and built for utilities—not everyday solar owners. Jasmine Energy changes that. Our AI-powered asset manager puts registration, compliance, and sales on autopilot, making it easy to turn solar generation into recurring income—with just a few clicks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65777&key=user_uploads/421/1c122467-5767-4a4e-b073-e88acd17faf4)

**TL;DR: Jasmine is the first end-to-end REC management platform built for residential and commercial solar. We automate common and confusing workflows—helping solar owners get paid extra for generating clean energy.** 

### **The Problem**

**Claiming RECs requires too much overhead for small or independent developers. (it works fine for the utility scale developers who designed it)**

Residential and commercial solar generators lose time and money navigating an outdated, fragmented system for managing Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs).

The industry still relies on paper, pens, and people. There’s no single source of truth, no standardized documentation, and no digital infrastructure to support efficient operations.

* **Complex registry compliance:** Each generator must register with one of several regional tracking systems, all with different rules, document requirements, and verification steps.
* **Manual data reporting:** Uploading generation data, proving eligibility, and submitting documents are tedious, inconsistent, and prone to error.
* **Inefficient monetization:** Selling RECs means navigating opaque markets, unclear pricing, and a maze of disconnected brokers and buyers—without a unified platform.

### **Our Solution – AI-Powered Automation for the Solar Industry**

**Use AI to “read” details from PDFs and to interact with legacy government websites.** 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65777&key=user_uploads/421/c7d2bd40-b6eb-4064-b70f-120b3eeb1ea9)

Jasmine replaces the outdated, paper-based REC management process with an AI-powered platform purpose-built for residential and commercial solar generators.

Our asset manager brings structure, standardization, and automation to an industry still running on spreadsheets and guesswork:

* **Automated registration:** Jasmine handles the full lifecycle of registration, reporting, and verification across all major tracking systems—no paperwork, no confusion.
* **Instant data processing:** Our AI ingests, validates, and submits generation data directly from inverters or utility portals to ensure RECs are accurately and efficiently issued.
* **Transparent payouts:** Track your REC sales in real time and get paid faster, with full visibility into pricing, status, and transaction history.

Jasmine turns a fragmented, manual process into a seamless, digital experience—so solar owners can focus on generating power, not paperwork.

### **Key Features**

📝 **Automated Asset Registration** – Jasmine handles onboarding your residential or commercial solar system into the appropriate REC tracking registry, eliminating paperwork and manual errors.

✅ **AI-Powered Data Validation** – Our platform connects to your inverter or utility portal to automatically validate and submit generation data in real time—ensuring fast, compliant REC issuance.

📈 **Transparent Reporting & Analytics** – Get a clean, centralized view of your REC portfolio: generation history, earnings, sale status, and payout timelines—all in one dashboard.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65777&key=user_uploads/421/e3f34226-de05-4e49-a60f-b4b95d079cfc)

### **Market Opportunity**

* **5M+ solar systems in the U.S.** eligible for REC sales.
* **$5B+ annual REC market** that is growing as corporations push for sustainability goals.
* **85% of small-scale generators** don’t currently monetize their RECs due to complexity.

### **Who We Are For**

🏠 **Home Solar Owners** \
Earn passive income from your rooftop solar—no spreadsheets, no stress. Jasmine fully automates REC registration, reporting, and sales so you can **get paid fast** for the clean energy you’re already producing.

🏢 \*\*Commercial Developers & Independent Power Producers (IPPs)\*\*\
Manage RECs across portfolios of solar assets with zero friction. Jasmine scales with your business—automating multi-site registration, streamlining compliance, and optimizing REC monetization from start to finish.

🤝 **Third Party Owners & Origination Teams** \
Third Party Owners (TPOs) own many thousands of small solar generators. Each site has the compliance overhead as a single utility scale facility. Jasmine helps  third party owners seamlessly register and track hundreds or even thousands of small distributed generators quickly and accurately.

### **Our Ask**

**If you have solar:**  \
Use the product!  You can upload your solar documents and claim your incentives TODAY -> <https://assets.jasmine.energy> 

**If you don't have solar:**  \
Introductions: Know a homeowner, business with solar, or a local solar installer? Refer them to Jasmine! Here’s a quick blurb you can share: 

_"Jasmine Energy automates Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) management for residential and commercial solar. We handle registration, compliance, and REC sales using AI-powered automation—so solar owners can earn passive income without lifting a finger."_

_📧:  _[_nathalie@jasmine.energy_](mailto:nathalie@jasmine.energy)

🔗 [jasmine.energy](http://jasmine.energy)

Join us in simplifying and scaling REC management for the clean energy transition. 🚀

**Nathalie, Dalton, and Matt**

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Jasmine makes it easy to claim, buy, and sell renewable energy certificates.

Hi Everyone! [Nathalie](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nathaliecapati-energy/), [Dalton](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tdaltonc/), and [Matt](https://linkedin.com/in/matthewmayberry) here to (re)introduce [**Jasmine Energy**](https://jasmine.energy/) 🔋

On Jasmine, anyone can claim, sell, buy, and retire [energy attributes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Energy_certificate) directly.

Energy attribute certificates (EACs) (sometimes called Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs)  are a $10B market that is stuck in a time capsule from the fax machine era. Today's EAC market is confusing and time-consuming, taking weeks to register and days to trade.\
\
We are on a mission to accelerate the net-zero transition by building climate asset markets that are accessible, transparent, and efficient.

**💢 The Problem**

RECs are a valuable source of revenue for renewable energy generators and are worth up to $500/MWh! The problem is EACs are still traded using phone calls and fax machines. The whole process is confusing and time-consuming, taking weeks to register and days to trade. Middlemen currently keep up to 30% of trade value. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73943&key=user_uploads/89898/29c68bd5-72fe-4072-86fc-e6d3b32cc819)

**🤝 The Solution**

On Jasmine, anyone can buy and sell EACs at a posted price, permissionless, with settlement in seconds.  

Jasmine helps users manage their renewable energy assets by bridging RECs onto the blockchain and enabling DeFi transactions that are impossible in the existing markets. When a tokenized EAC is retired, Jasmine handles regulatory filings and auditing (filing paperwork, making phone calls, etc).

Jasmine provides the infrastructure to make every step of the buy and sell side process more efficient and transparent, allowing renewable energy generators to make more money, enabling commercial buyers to have a verifiable audit trail of their energy consumption, and giving energy traders the tools to operate more efficiently.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73943&key=user_uploads/89898/1700472b-a8b3-49b3-8eac-f0bb4076432b)

**♻️ How does this directly help the climate?**

Under business as usual, we're not going to build enough global clean energy capacity to hit our 2050 goal of (1) electrifying the economy, (2) decarbonizing the electricity grid, and (3) improving people's quality of life by expanding access to affordable electricity. 

A more liquid EAC market will make renewable energy projects less risky to finance, attracting new investors to accelerate the grid’s decarbonization.  We’re bringing those EACs onto the blockchain not just for the transparency and liquidity benefits, but also because DeFi will quickly generate the financial derivatives to further incentivize project financing.

launches.title: 🔎 Nucleus - LLM search across sales transcripts for Product Marketing teams
launches.tagline: LLM powered conversational search engine over sales calls that helps product marketing teams discover what to build and pitch at the speed of thought.
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Product marketing teams spend hours listening to sales calls or using archaic keyword searches that often lead to false positives. We are building an LLM-powered search engine so Product Marketing teams can unlock the gold that exists in hundreds or thousands of sales calls. Nucleus automatically indexes and buckets hundreds of attributes per B2B client, such as objections, feature requests, and competitor mentions, to power your insights.

Hi everyone, we’re Akash, Nikhil, and Anirudh - the team behind Nucleus.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80334&key=user_uploads/583810/72ab75fc-307a-4e61-b6e9-bca1a0756bcb)

# **🧨 The problem - hours spent listening to calls**

Product marketing teams spend hours listening to sales call recordings or painfully searching through transcripts by keywords to inform their sales pitch, marketing campaigns, upsells/cross-sells, and product roadmap. 

Take our client Jacob as an example. Jacob is a Product Marketing Manager who is responsible for positioning his product against competitors. He has to sit through call recordings to understand how prospects perceive competitors and how his company’s pitch is resonating with clients. He even hired a sales enablement analyst recently to organize calls and deliver insights to him.

# 🎉 **The solution - ask Nucleus**

Nucleus empowers PMMs with **Revenue Reasoning** and **Revenue Observability** to convert thousands of sales calls into actionable insights.

With Nucleus Revenue Reasoning, product marketing teams can ask Nucleus a question in plain English like “Show me stage 1 prospects that were previously using Zoominfo for prospecting and what are their limitations with it?”. Nucleus will answer the question directly with LLM reasoning, along with supporting evidence from client calls.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80334&key=user_uploads/208653/ea5c36a8-aec6-4dac-828b-17f0abbcedb3)

Rather than relying on just keywords that often lead to false positives, with Nucleus Revenue Observability, Jacob can set up LLM-powered smart trackers that ping him in real-time when something he cares about happens in a call, such as when a prospect describes how they perceive a competitor. Nucleus’s LLMs go beyond archaic and often unfruitful keyword matching and instead reason over entire calls to deliver insights.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80334&key=user_uploads/208653/523b9be7-9531-457f-9e71-ea11e5c29e4b)

# **👋 Asks**

**Follow our journey on **[**Twitter**](https://twitter.com/NucleusLLM)** & **[**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nucleus-yc)**.**

* If you are a B2B company that does more than 30 calls a week, [talk to us to see](https://calendly.com/akash-88/nucleus-ai) if we can be of help.

Thank You 🙏

You are a B2C SaaS, e-Commerce, Marketplace, FinTech company with tons of tickets growing every day, support is becoming really expensive and **your Intercom bot solves 30% of the tickets** after either you or your head of ops **spent hundreds of hours finding and creating examples to train the bot.** (A notable portion of which are customers who just rage quit and counted as contained)

## **✨ Our Solution**

### Automatic Answering Bot

* Learn from your FAQ, past agent responses AND agent actions to **2-3x your current chatbot’s containment to 70 - 90%**

* **More than just a simple embeddings search fed into GPT** - our proprietary algorithm uses statistical modeling to adjust answer relevancy and filter out irrelevant or case-specific content to ensure vetted and up-to-date answers
* Promptly perform the actions that your customers request when the right conditions are met

### Agent Assist

* Draft answers and allow agents to **perform lengthy yet repetitive actions** with **a single click**, saving up to **80% of handle time**
* Surface the **relevant customer data** at the **right time** to give your agents confidence without cluttering their workspace with unnecessary details

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69276&key=user_uploads/699631/93ad40ec-16f6-4bca-8ca7-581efe7ac9c3)

3. 3-month pilot where we will be your consultant **customizing integrations and features just for you** and making sure we deliver on the promise; **no engineering lift from your end**
4. An official rollout with our solution set, which will then become completely self-served

## **🙏 Our ask**

Thank you so much!

This business had no subscription program, which by this point had become a popular thing in the car wash industry. The site was also surrounded by several well established competitors.\\Instead of offering an identical subscription model that gave customers a single wash unlimited I wanted to do something different. Our subscription gave customers more flexibility and combined multiple packages from our menu, allowing them to both clean the car themselves and take advantage of options where we cleaned the car for them all for a recurring monthly fee.\\I searched the industry for a solution that would help me do this and found none. launches.tagline: GradientJ helps product teams deploy large language models at scale. Companies use us to create GPT3 applications and monitor them in production.
launches.body:
### **What is it?**

GradientJ is a web application to build, compare, and deploy prompts for large language models like GPT3.

### **Is this for me?**

GradientJ is for:

* Product teams that are just **thinking of using something like GPT3** in their product and are **trying to figure out how to get started**.
* Teams who are **already using LLMs** to delight their customers and are **trying to level up their workflow** with faster iteration, better organization, easy cost and performance comparisons, and the on-ramp to \~_the mythical land of fine-tuning\~_.

### **What’s the Problem?**

Currently, the **road from exciting prototype output with ChatGPT to production-ready GPT3 deployment is unclear** and littered with potential pitfalls.

Even for the teams that do get version 1 out the door, **the workflow often ends up as a stitched together hodgepodge of makeshift processes and tools.**

LLM deployment is a leading cause of “am I doing this right?”-itis. Symptoms include:

* A text document with examples copy-pasted into the OpenAI playground
* A prompt comparison process that consists of an eyeball test followed by “looks better-ish”
* Hours spent tweaking a prompt on one example only to find, in the end, it breaks on all the others
* Nightmares of users getting nonsensical or offensive output from a hallucinating LLM

### **How do we solve it?**

We made a prompt engineering interface that:

Automatically suggests starting points or improvements to your prompts.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68762&key=user_uploads/314229/aabfc294-5d59-4f02-a9a0-ff9ea4e2a1b0)

Tracks prompt versions and benchmark examples so you can always compare and deploy the best iteration.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68762&key=user_uploads/314229/2491d923-0562-4c55-aa1c-fe0837a3b899)

Deploys to your own API endpoint with automatic cost and performance tracking in one click.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68762&key=user_uploads/314229/df784795-2290-4ce9-9fbe-90ec41fbb21b)

# **The Ask:**

* **Let us help:** If you’re trying to use LLMs like GPT3 in your application and want to discuss how to **get version 1 out the door** **FAST**, we’d love to talk.
* **Try it out:** If you’re already using LLMs in your application, we’d love to talk.

launches.body:
### TL;DR

TableFlow enables enterprises to extract and transform unstructured data from CSVs, PDFs, images, and web pages. Instead of spending time on manual data entry and validation, teams use TableFlow to automate these tasks with AI.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73464&key=user_uploads/405594/c161bc5a-7c2f-45d1-8e93-39ea826fc6a6)

Hi everyone, we’re Eric and Mitch from [TableFlow](http://tableflow.com)! 👋

### Problem

Many companies rely on spreadsheets, PDFs, and other file types to import partner or customer data, which exists in a variety of formats. This difficult and time-consuming process often leads to companies relying on a combination of in-house tooling and manual work to migrate the data. This becomes even more problematic when ingesting hundreds or thousands of files a week.

### Solution

TableFlow handles the file import process with automated pipelines that use AI to map, extract, transform, and validate data.

**How it works:**

1. Define your destination schema in our app. These are the columns and data types that you want to transform data to.
2. Import a file via our API.
3. Receive a webhook when the file finishes processing (takes \~10 seconds, even with 100k+ records). This will include any errors, such as a required field being missing.
4. Optional: Review the imported data in our application before continuing.
5. Import the cleaned, transformed data into your system.

[Demo Video](https://www.loom.com/share/a07bfd2c55454127afa44df31a973c81?sid=42c402db-1ee5-4886-a009-484bcdc1df3a)

### TEAM

We met while working at Heymarket, a Series-A startup in SF. Mitch was the first product hire, and Eric was the first full-stack engineer. During our two years there, we co-owned many projects and defined many of the engineering & product processes to help the company scale. We became friends outside of the office by talking about startups, tennis, pickleball, and mountain biking.

[Mitch](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mitchpatin/) started his career as an engineer before moving to the dark side (product 😛). He previously worked at GE Digital and Bolt and founded a company focused on B2B payments.

[Eric](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ericciminelli/) is a software engineer who previously worked at Facebook and myMatrixx and co-founded a company that created a search engine for car shopping online.

### Asks

💌 If your team handles recurring imports of data in different schemas and formats, we’d love to hear about the problems you’ve encountered. Just leave your info [here,](https://tableflow.com/join-waitlist) and we’ll reach out!

launches.tagline: Mantys helps SaaS companies calculate and forecast their ARR accurately in real time without using multiple spreadsheets.
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We are excited to Launch [Mantys](https://mantys-new-d3fdb94a4d5f489b27ad571898cf.webflow.io/#top) to all of you!

Mantys helps SaaS startups get **real-time visibility of their ARR Cycle**. If you struggle to know what your contracted, live and realised ARR are at given point of time or need to go through a lot of manual effort to reach there, we can help you.

**Problem:**

As companies grow, revenue is not just revenue, it is Contracted ARR, Live ARR, Realised ARR, Churn, expansion, etc. and it becomes increasingly difficult to keep a track of them due to:

* **Data sitting in disparate locations:** Contracted ARR sits in CRM(Salesforce/Hubspot), Billed ARR sits in a billing software(Stripe, Chargebee), Churn sits in CS software(Gainsight) or Excel sheets, so on and so forth.
* **Most of the tracking ends up happening in Google/Excel sheets** which leads to dependency on individuals, high chance of errors and inability to handle multi-dimensional data
* **Difficult to forecast complex business models:** SaaS has matured and there are complex pricing models like usage based, hybrid emerging which makes customer level forecasting even more difficult.

As a result, founders/CFOs are not able to answer fundamental questions like what their ARR is, how much is actually realised, what is the onboarding cycle, how will it impact cash flow etc. at any given point of time leading to governance issues and lack of actionable insights. **It takes them 5-7 days every month to just compute revenue metrics.**

![Twitter 上的Chetan Puttagunta："There's ARR and then there's ARR  https://t.co/XMKKkooAsM" / Twitter](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E34eGfvUUAADQ6C.jpg)

**The solution**

Mantys helps SaaS companies calculate and forecast their ARR accurately in real time without using multiple spreadsheets. For example, NextBillion uses Mantys to pull data from HubSpot and Chargebee and create real-time views of their Contracted ARR, Billed ARR, Churn, and forecasted ARR.

We enable them to:

* **Establish a single source of truth and automate processes:** Integrate with CRM, Accounting and Billing software to get real time visibility of your Contracted ARR, Billed ARR, Realised ARR, Unearned ARR, Expansion, Contraction, Churn, etc., broken down at customer & cohort level and use the data cleaning layer to reduce 80% of manual effort
* **Get actionable insights and take corrective action faster:** Know the exact cycle between Contracted to Billed to Realised and reasons for discrepancies for different dimensions like time period, region, industry, etc,. and take actions preemptively to avoid accidents
* **Simulate different what-if scenarios in minutes and forecast:** Build different scenarios to see how Bookings will translate into billing and cash flow and forecast at a customer/cohort level taking into consideration both revenue and usage data

**We know every business is complex and has it nuances. We have however, solved this problem for multiple Series A+ SaaS companies like MoEngage, Locus, etc. and have identified patterns for data cleaning and transformation across businesses. And we know how to handle them.**

* Recording Unbilled or unearned entries? Just enter on the system
* Usage based revenue? Integrate your usage data
* Don’t have a common identifier across systems? We can handle it.
* Multiple entity or currency issues? Don’t worry, we will convert it.

And we provide best-in-class templates which help SaaS startups get up and running in days with very minimal effort involved from their end.

**Our ask:**

* Have trouble figuring out your ARR lifecycle? Schedule time to chat here: <https://calendly.com/kriti-25/kritiarora_mantys>
* If you know any growth stage SaaS company who might be a fit, please introduce us.

launches.title: Kyber LetterGen 📝 Compose and send complex claim notices
launches.tagline: We help claims teams instantly draft, review, and send complex notices.
launches.body:
**_tldr;_** _We make it simple for claims teams to instantly draft, review, and send complex notices to insureds, claimants, and third parties (like attorneys). With GenAI draft generation, real-time collaborative editing, integrated review workflows, and omnichannel delivery, Kyber’s LetterGen is able to supercharge the process of creating claim denial, partial denial, and settlement notices for even the most complex claims._ **Book a demo on our [website](https://askkyber.com?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=claims_launch_yc) to learn more!**

**—**

# **🧨 Problem: Regulated notices are tedious and high-risk.**

For claims teams, state departments of insurance typically have very clear guidelines around the specific types of notices an insurer is supposed to provide to the parties involved. These include notices like claim acknowledgment, status updates, proactive reservations of rights, and finally, either a claim denial, partial denial, or settlement letter detailing what finally is or isn’t covered.

While that may seem straightforward, many organizations fail to meet these requirements as adjustors struggle to efficiently write notices up to the required quality bar. Numerous carriers we’ve talked to and currently work with have audited their claims organizations and found that their teams spend upwards of **30% of their working hours** just handling these notices.

Why? Many times, these notices end up in a court of law where an unhappy claimant will sue the insurer, arguing that the notice was ambiguous.

# **🎉 Solution: One platform to consolidate, collaborate, and send notices.**

Kyber’s LetterGen helps companies streamline their notice creation process, removing tedious overhead and minimizing risk from claimants suing companies for acting in bad faith.

![](https://www.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=79877&key=user_uploads/271067/33ede188-d105-4957-a9e3-5f109a3b9320)

Out of the box, Kyber’s LetterGen comes with:

* Automatic policy language extraction 🔍
* Personalized draft creation powered by GenAI 🤖
* Integrated review workflow ⭐
* Real-time collaborative editing and commenting 💬
* Full history and version tracking support 🕗
* Basic template creation and management 📄
* Progress tracking across your notice funnel 📊
* Pre-built integrations into claims systems and mailing systems ✉️

### **Our ask 🙏**

* Connect us with Operations or Claims leaders at TPAs, Carriers, MGAs, or Reinsurers ➡️ [sav@askkyber.com](https://mailto:sav@askkyber.com).
* If you or your organization operate in a regulated industry (Healthcare, Loans, Banking, Utilities, etc.) and are required to generate similar notices for third parties, we’d love to learn more ➡️ [founders@askkyber.com](mailto:founders@askkyber.com)

# TL;DR Instead of digging across resources to find the right answer, Kyber provides highly specific and accurate answers right at your fingertips.

### Who Is It For?

Any company/enterprise that gets repeat questions about the same thing over and over again that they’ve already documented or answered.

### How It Works

⚡ Install our **Slack/Discord/Front/Intercom** Apps each in **two clicks**

**⚙️** We’ll ingest your knowledge base (typically public documentation) and configure them into your preferred access channels

**❓** Go to town asking Kyber for help on questions about your knowledge base

🔍 Gain important insights into user questions and team questions, which you can then use to further refine your knowledge base

🚀 Accelerate support, onboarding, and more at speed of AI

Direct Response Flow:

![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=69780&key=user_uploads/271067/061a2882-761b-4b9d-83cf-edf2fc8ba501)

Hidden Response Flow:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69780&key=user_uploads/271067/98d2c6ea-889d-45a7-a4bc-33b6d11a4626)

# Why We Built Kyber

🤔 We started Kyber because we were frustrated with the tradeoffs that different resources and support channels provide today. At the end of the day, we realized that end users just want factually correct answers and they want them NOW.

Existing resources each make tradeoffs between speed, relevance, and trust:

* Documentation (Immediately available, but not easy to search or always up to date): 
  * Speed ✅
  * Relevance ❌
  * Trust ✅
* Community (Friendly, but not sure if answers are trustworthy):
  * Speed ✅
  * Relevance ✅
  * Trust ❌
* Support Staff (Relevant and trustworthy answers, but usually very slow):
  * Speed ❌
  * Relevance ✅
  * Trust  ✅

We help bridge these gaps by either providing your users a direct interface for help or by enabling your CX teams to quickly search and generate answers using our flows.

# How Can I Try It?

Email us at [founders@askkyber.com](mailto:founders@askkyber.com)

We’ll set up a custom demo where you’ll be able to try it out firsthand on top of your chosen knowledge base. Once you’re happy, we’ll give you and your team a white-glove onboarding experience.

Have any additional flows, knowledge base sources, or integrations in mind? Let us know! We’re more than happy to support it and already have a few more exciting features planned for the future (stay tuned 😉).

### **TLDR: Traditional automation software is slow and expensive, Automat is 10X faster and 1/10th the price. It lets operations teams automate using natural language.**

Howdy y’all! Lucas here from [Automat](https://www.getlassoai.com/) - excited to share what my cofounder Gautam and I have been working on!

**🧐 The problem: Traditional Robotic Process Automation is slow and expensive.**

It’s extremely time consuming and expensive to build out robot process automations using traditional tools like UiPath (\~$66,000 per yearly license - Yikes!) not to mention the initial consultant setup fees which most people are forced to pay if they don’t have the resources in house (at the lowest end we’re talking $50,000+ per project - Double Yikes!!)

💡 **Our Solution: Automat makes it 10X cheaper and faster to build any robotic process automation using natural language on chrome.**

We’re solving this by creating a platform that enables robotics process automation for Chrome using large language models and computer vision.

Currently our customers send us descriptions or videos of the processes they’d like us to automate and we use our internal tooling to quickly build out those automations.

Here is one of our customer’s attended bots in action, scraping an email, looking through a prospecting tool, and saving it to a spreadsheet.

name: Yuma AI
long_description:
## What is Yuma AI?

Yuma is automating customer support by providing an AI Support Agent orchestration platform. Yuma provides autonomous AI agents dedicated to customer service and e-commerce.

We integrate directly with help desk software (Zendesk, Kustomer, Gorgias, etc.) and focus on helping large Shopify brands deal with their high volume of support requests.

Top merchants using Yuma can automate up to 80% of their support tickets fully autonomously.

## Why do Shopify merchants need Yuma?

There are thousands of large Shopify merchants around the world generating $10M+ a year. Most of them have taken over some niches and are great at what they do: selling their products.

But they all have one thing in common: they all hate customer support. It's a burden for them and a huge source of cost, as they receive hundreds of requests per day. Some of them have dozens of support agents on staff, usually offshore, and the overall quality is still often pretty poor while staff turnover remains high.

Those merchants have been promised automation for years but have always been disappointed by the outcome. As customers, we have all had to live through a terrible support automation experience before, so this is no secret, and everyone knows that the current state of the technology is quite bad.

## Yuma is solving this in a few ways:

Yuma isn't just another RAG chatbot. Our platform provides autonomous AI agents dedicated to support and ecommerce.

These agents are powered by knowledge, follow processes, and are managed by our in-house AI orchestration technology. This ensures safety, control, and quality at every step.

We believe that to truly automate customer support, we must develop a platform that mimics the actions of a human support agent. That's exactly what we've been doing.

Currently, our top merchants are automating 60% of their support tickets through Yuma. Yuma can fetch information from external services and take actions in other apps as needed to resolve each ticket.

We are laser-focused on building the best AI support agent platform and aim to achieve 80% true automation in the next few months.

## Fun Fact

Yuma got started by accident. This is my third YC startup after Socialcam (W12) and Triplebyte (S15). I released Yuma as a prototype for fun in mid-December 2022 and was overwhelmed with demo requests. That's when I knew I was onto something and had to turn this into a real company, once again.
one_liner: The AI Support Agent for Ecommerce

launches.title: Yuma Voice: Your AI support agent now answers the phone
launches.tagline: AI phone support for brands. Resolves requests and takes real actions, with a unified, single Handbook to define the rules for your AI agents across every channel.
launches.body:
👋 We are Yuma, YC W23, and since 2023, We have automated millions of customer conversations for retail & ecommerce brands.

Today we're launching Yuma Voice. The same AI agent that handles your email, chat, and WhatsApp can now answer your phone!

This one took many, many months of work and iteration from the whole team. I'm very proud to finally put it in your hands :)

**Why we built it**

We have spent years teaching AI agents how to actually resolve customer requests: understand the problem, follow the brand's policies, look things up, and take the right action.

We wanted to bring all of that to the phone. But making seamless at the same time.

Voice is a totally different beast. It has to be fast, accurate, and personable. One awkward pause or misunderstanding, and the customer hears it immediately. But the hardest part was making it as capable as the rest of our agents.

A customer calls at 11pm to skip her next delivery. Yuma picks up, finds her subscription, confirms the change, updates it during the call, and tells her when the next delivery will arrive.

That's the experience we've been working toward.

**What it does**

* **Takes real actions during the call.** Update an address, cancel an order, process a return, or change a subscription while the customer is still on the line.
* **Uses everything you've already configured.** Same knowledge, same processes, same guardrails as your existing Yuma agents. Nothing to retrain or duplicate.
* **Speaks 30+ languages.** It can follow the customer even when they switch languages mid-call.
* **Works on your phone number and your website.** Connect your existing telephony or add a browser call button.
* **Hands over when it should.** You decide when to transfer to a human or collect an email for follow-up. Recordings and transcripts give your team the context.
* **Lets you start small.** Run it after hours, on weekends, or on a portion of calls. Listen to the conversations and expand when you're comfortable.

It plugs into the helpdesk and ecommerce tools you already use, with voice conversations alongside the rest of your support activity.

**Try it yourself**

☎️ [Call Emily, our live demo](https://yuma.ai/voice-demo).

She handles support for Daybreak Coffee, our fictional demo store. Pick a sample customer on the page, ask to skip a shipment or change a subscription, and see how she handles it.

You can call directly from your browser. It’s that easy!

Please try it and give me blunt feedback. That's why we're launching here :)

**Looking for**

Are you running a retail brand with phone support, or thinking about offering it?

We would love to help you connect Yuma Voice, set up your first processes, and review the results together. Contact Guillaume, the founder below, or [book a demo](https://yuma.ai/voice-ai-agent).

And if you know a brand whose team spends too much time handling repetitive calls, send them our way 👀

Contact Guillaume, the founder at g-voice-ai-launch@yuma.ai for priority setup.

**What else does Yuma do?**

Yuma brings your entire customer service operation into a single platform. Email, chat, social, WhatsApp, and now voice, with AI agents handling both inbound and outbound conversations across every channel.

Whether customers contact you or your agents reach out first, it all runs through Yuma. A single Handbook defines the rules, and a single tool lets you manage the full customer experience.

Yuma is AI for CX infrastructure.

launches.title: Ask Yuma: The AI that runs your entire support operation
launches.tagline: Commerce brands can now build automations, investigate ticket issues, find optimization opportunities, and generate reports by talking to their AI platform in plain English.
launches.body:
👋 We are **Yuma (YC W23)**, the AI agent layer for commerce CX. We started building on OpenAI's Davinci model in late 2022 and have processed millions of customer conversations for 100+ commerce brands since.

Today we are launching **Ask Yuma**. Think Claude Code, but for your entire CX operation. A conversational AI built into every page of the Yuma dashboard.

**Demo video:**

<https://youtu.be/qqc3XGCEHAc?si=8X4Lx4DatRe1fJMX>

Ask Yuma knows your entire support operation: tickets, automations, knowledge base, metrics, integrations, brand voice. You tell it what you want in plain English. It does the work.

**Why we built it**

Since 2023, Yuma has automated millions of customer interactions for commerce brands. Our best merchants automate 93% of their customer conversations. The automation works.

But configuring it was still painful. Merchants had SOPs in Google Docs they couldn't turn into live automations without our help. They wanted to investigate why a ticket was handled wrong but had to file a request and wait. They knew there were more tickets to automate but finding them meant hours of manual digging.

The dependency on our team was the bottleneck. So we built Ask Yuma: one conversational interface that puts all of that in the merchant's hands, with our team still there when they need us.

**What it does**

**Build automations from documents:** Upload any SOP or process doc. Ask Yuma reads it, asks clarifying questions, generates a visual flowchart, and produces a complete automation ready to go live. What used to take days takes 1 conversation.

**Find automation opportunities:** Ask Yuma analyzes your escalated tickets, ranks recommendations by impact, and links to real examples so you can verify before acting.

**Diagnose issues:** Ask "why was this ticket handled wrong?" Ask Yuma traces the root cause through your configuration and tells you what to change.

**Generate reports:** Ask for a report of every product defect reported this week. Ask Yuma searches thousands of tickets, pulls the images, and generates a PDF you can share with your exec team or manufacturer.

**Monitor performance:** Track automation rate, CSAT trends, unusual spikes, and compare time periods in plain English. No dashboards to build.

It doesn't stop there. Ask Yuma finds what's broken, proposes a plan, gets your approval, implements the fix, tests it in a sandbox, and verifies it worked.

In just 1 week of internal release, Ask Yuma has seen 60% adoption among existing merchants.

launches.title: Social AI: Put E-commerce Social Media on Autopilot
launches.tagline: Safely automate social media moderation across Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
launches.body:
👋 We are Yuma, YC W23. Since 2023, we've automated over 5 million customer interactions for leading e-commerce brands with Support AI and Sales AI. Today we're launching our newest product: **Social AI**

Social AI puts your brand's social media comments on autopilot. It connects to your Facebook, Instagram, and soon TikTok pages, ingests every comment in real time, classifies each one by intent and sentiment, and acts based on automation rules you define. In early testing, Social AI safely automates up to 60% of repetitive social media moderation.

**Why this matters**: because social comments are one of the last unmanaged channels in e-commerce. They're public, they shape brand perception, and most teams have no system for handling them. And "safely" matters here. One careless AI reply on a post can reach thousands of eyes in minutes.

**Why we built it**

We kept hearing the same thing from customer support and social teams at high-growth brands: social comments are a blind spot.

* "A negative comment sits on a post for days and nobody can catch it."
* "Someone asked a product question under our Instagram ad. By the time we saw it, they'd already bought from a competitor."
* "A frustrated customer tagged us publicly. It snowballed into 40+ replies before anyone on our team even noticed."
* "A customer leaves a glowing comment and we don't even say thank you."
* "We have 1 person manually scrolling through hundreds of comments."

Support tickets have tools. Social comments didn't. We've been running Social AI in private beta for the past year. Today, after a major upgrade, we're opening it up to everyone.

**What's different**

* Works across both paid and organic posts. Negative comments on your ads are conversion killers, and Social AI catches them before they cost you.
* Built-in automation templates for common scenarios (reply, like, hide, flag, or skip), with the ability to create fully custom rules
* Configurable agent persona: set the tone, verbosity, and brand guidelines so replies sound like your team wrote them
* Advanced targeting based on the commenter's follower count, so high-profile users get the extra care they deserve
* Crisis prevention: automatically detect and escalate comments that could spiral into bigger brand issues before they do
* 24/7 coverage. 50% of comments are posted outside business hours and on weekends. Social AI is always on so your brand is never unprotected.
* Safety first: every automation rule is scoped by platform, intent, sentiment, and user popularity. You stay in control of what gets automated and what doesn't
* Real-time dashboard with engagements, automation coverage, sentiment distribution, negative exposure rate, and unanswered rate across all platforms

**The demo video:**

<https://youtu.be/6X6W_k6Cs8c>

**Looking for:**

Are you running an e-commerce brand and leaving social comments unmanaged? We'd love to help you set up Social AI, configure your automations, and track the impact with a 30-day free trial. 👀

Contact Guillaume, the founder at [g-social-ai-launch@yuma.ai](mailto:g-social-ai-launch@yuma.ai) for priority setup.

**What else does Yuma do?**

We also offer AI agents for e-commerce support (Support AI) and a product page Q&A widget to boost conversion (Sales AI). On top of that, our platform includes a visual automation builder (Flows) and a ChatGPT-like interface for surfacing customer voice insights from support tickets (Deep Search). :)
