launches.body:
👋 We’re **Yuma (YC W23)**, an AI agent platform **dedicated to e-commerce brands**. Similar to Sierra and Decagon but built for **high-volume retail support**.

Today we are launching **Deep Search**, our latest innovation for unlocking **Customer Voice**.

Deep Search is an **LLM-powered conversational search engine** on top of your support ticket history (your entire support **ticket cloud**). Instead of digging through dashboards or exports, you ask questions in plain language and get **clear, sourced answers** straight from recent customer conversations.

### Why we built it

Since 2023, Yuma has helped brands resolve **millions of support tickets**. CX teams kept asking questions that no tool could answer well:

* _“Which products are generating defects or breakage complaints this week?”_
* _“What is driving checkout abandonment and what are customers saying about it?”_
* _“Are refund requests spiking for a specific SKU or variant?”_
* _“What new issues are trending right now that we did not even know about?”_

Dashboards only show the metrics you already track. The real **Customer Voice lives in the support tickets**.

### Why it matters

Deep Search gives you insights **in minutes** that used to take **days of manual work** or were simply not economically viable to produce. Until today, no one had the time or budget to manually read and analyze hundreds or thousands of support tickets.

Now you get that work done **instantly**. Product, CX, ops, and growth leaders can finally:

* Spot **product defects** before they create churn
* Identify **friction points** that slow or block purchases
* Surface **refund and return patterns** across SKUs
* Detect **trending issues early** and intervene fast
* Ship improvements backed by **real customer data**
* Turn support into a **compounding ROI engine**

Deep Search makes your support tickets an **always-on source of business intelligence**.

### What it does

Deep Search:

* Scans your entire **support ticket cloud** in seconds
* Identifies themes like product defects, shipping issues, sizing confusion, checkout friction, or subscription churn
* Surfaces patterns that teams usually miss until it is too late
* Returns concise analysis with **real ticket snippets** you can click into
* Supports **follow-up questions** with full conversational context
* Generates reports on anything you ask for and **emails them on a schedule**
* Helps CX, product, ops, and growth teams move from **reactive to proactive**

Deep Search turns your support history (your ticket cloud) into a **live Customer Voice layer** you can explore, monitor, and automate.

Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V7t4UDkFbxM

### Looking for

We are looking for e-commerce brands that want to use support data for **decision-making**, not just firefighting. We will help you plug in Deep Search, define your key questions, and track the impact.

Contact Guillaume (the founder) at [**g-sales-ai-launch@yuma.ai**](mailto:g-sales-ai-launch@yuma.ai) for early access.

### What else does Yuma do

Yuma also offers **AI agents for e-commerce support** and **Sales AI** for product-page Q&A. Top brands automate up to **70%** of support with us.

### What should we build next?

We are adding **dynamic charts**, trend visualizations, and anomaly alerts to Deep Search. If there is something specific you want to analyze or ask from your support tickets, tell us. We are shaping the roadmap based on what brands need most.

launches.title: Flows: AI Agent Builder for Precise, Reliable Ecommerce Support
launches.tagline: Visual Step-by-Step Builder for Ecommerce Support
launches.body:
👋 We’re **Yuma (YC W23)**, an AI support platform for e-commerce, and today we’re launching one of our biggest updates yet: **Flows**, a visual automation builder for ecommerce support.

**Flows** expands Yuma’s AI agents’ capabilities with a visual builder for explicit, deterministic steps. You can now combine process-based AI agents with the reliability of a flow for faster, more precise CX automation.

### **Why we built it**

For more than 2 years, Yuma has helped merchants automate customer support using our natural-language AI Agents builder, resolving over 5 million tickets to date. But as merchants grow, they need more control, advanced workflows, and precision while staying flexible and easy to maintain.

That’s why we built **Flows**, a visual, step-by-step builder that adds structure, clarity, and reliability to AI automation.

### **What it does**

Flows let merchants visually define how an SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) runs, step by step and action by action. Each step is visible, enforced, and powered by a mix of good old hard code and LLMs.

Flows combine quick ramp-up and adaptability with _strict step-by-step control_ where it matters.

With Flows, you can:

* Build if/then logic visually with guaranteed execution
* Combine AI conversations and deterministic rules
* Review and debug complex automations in minutes
* Gather clear insights and metrics on automation paths
* Use hooks and ordered API & CRM calls for full consistency

### **Why it matters**

Flows make automation more reliable and easier to maintain. It brings three major advantages:

**Step-by-step precision:** Every action runs exactly as designed, with enterprise-grade reliability you can trust.\
**Visual clarity:** Instantly see, review, and debug every step of your automations, no guessing or black boxes.\
**Hybrid flexibility:** Combine LLM adaptability with structured, reliable workflows for the best of both worlds.

The result is higher accuracy, fewer escalations, and faster resolutions, all in a visual format you can refine in minutes.

### **The demo video**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6J1OMGCM2v0

### **Looking for**

We’re looking for merchants and DTC brand owners who want to test **Flows** and share honest feedback 👀

We’ll help you build your first Flow, monitor accuracy, and measure results.

Contact Guillaume, the founder, at [g-sales-ai-launch@yuma.ai](mailto:g-sales-ai-launch@yuma.ai) for early access.

### **What's Yuma's full suite of products?**

Flows is part of Yuma’s full suite. Top brands automate up to 70% of support with us. With 3 main products — Support AI, Sales AI, and Social AI — we integrate with helpdesks like Gorgias, Zendesk, Kustomer, Gladly, Front, and Salesforce (I know, even Salesforce!!) to automate support, pre-sales, social interactions, and more.

👋 We are Yuma, YC W23. Today, on top of already automating customer service for more than a hundred merchants, we are launching our latest product: **Sales AI**

Sales AI is a product Q&A widget dedicated to Shopify. It sits on each PDP (product page), suggests the top questions a shopper is likely to ask, and answers instantly. If they want more, a lightweight chat opens with a fuller answer. From there, they can add to cart inside the chat or get more recommendations.

Why this matters: because the future is shopping, not chat! Shoppers want info delivered to them before they ask for it! Most drops happen on PDPs because of missing information.

Sales AI reduces that friction and in controlled A/B tests lifts conversion by up to 14%! It also records what people asked, which answers helped, and where they still hesitated, so as a brand, you see the "why" behind purchases and bounces.

**What’s different:**

* Tailored FAQs per product and per visitor behavior
* Uses your existing Shopify data + policies + prior support knowledge
* A/B test friendly; 2-click to install; doesn’t slow the site
* Full dashboard & insights with Yuma-driven revenue/purchases, impressions, interaction rate

One of our early partners, **Parachute Home**, credits the product with improving both customer experience and revenue. “Our shoppers love the interactive FAQ widget. They get answers fast, and on desktop, in one A/B test, we saw our Revenue Per Visitor increase +18% and our Average Order Value +4% - Mehdi Ait Oufkir, CEO of Parachute Home.”

launches.tagline: Yuma is using LLMs to automate support for Shopify merchants
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** _Thousands of large Shopify stores all share the same pain: a costly and inefficient customer support. Yuma leverages LLMs and integrates directly with help desks to automate away their high volume of support requests._

## **The Yuma Story**

Hi everyone,

I'm G and I'm very pleased to be launching [Yuma](https://yuma.ai), my third company!

**I did YC twice before** already, with Socialcam (W12) and Triplebyte (S15). It seems like I just can't help myself, and I had to do it all over again.

This time around, however, it's a little bit special as Yuma was launched by accident 🤷‍♂️. I released a prototype in December 2022, and my inbox was inundated with installation requests from Shopify merchants. That's when I knew I was onto something, and I decided to take the plunge. Having experienced that roller coaster ride before, I know exactly what I am signing up for again and I am thrilled about the long and eventful journey that lies ahead.

## **Why do Shopify merchants need Yuma?**

There are thousands of Shopify merchants around the world generating $10M+ a year, and they all have one thing in common: **they all hate customer support**. It's a burden for them and a huge source of cost as **they receive hundreds of requests per day**. Some of them have dozens of support agents on staff, usually offshore, and the overall quality is still often pretty poor, while staff turnover remains high.

Those merchants have been promised automation for years, but the technology has always fallen short, leaving them disappointed. As customers, we have all had to live through a terrible support automation experience before, so it's no secret that **the available current solutions are pretty bad**.

**This has to change**, and we believe that the technology is finally there to fix this problem once and for all. Of course, our goal is for Yuma to do it :)

## **The main things Yuma can do for merchants today:**

* **One-click install** into **help desks**: **no configuration required**, zero adoption cost, and no change in workflows for the support agents.
* By **combining LLMs with custom knowledge bases**, Yuma suggests drafts to support agents.
* By analyzing historical tickets, Yuma can **copy the writing style of any brand**, but also understand and **replicate their current workflows** autonomously.
* By bringing the power of LLMs to rules and templates, Yuma delivers a new type of dynamic workflow that wasn't possible before.

Yuma is already live on Gorgias at the moment, and our Zendesk app will be live in a few weeks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69885&key=user_uploads/37163/858ab524-d3ce-461b-968c-43ba41dea793)


## **Our ask 🙏**

Do a good deed today and **save a Shopify merchant in your network by telling them about Yuma**. They will be forever grateful! Not only that, they will receive a white-glove onboarding experience along with a 7-day free trial. :)

— —

Thank you for reading!

🔥

launches.tagline: Automatically create LLM-based evals aligned with human judgement
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** [Parea AI](https://www.parea.ai/) automates the creation of evals for your AI products. We achieve this by bootstrapping an evaluation function with human annotations. Allowing you to automagically turn “vibe checks” into scalable and reliable evaluations aligned with human judgment.

# **😩 The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82145&key=user_uploads/501039/78024ed1-9aa2-4be8-a022-359d82b9ac59)

Evaluating free-form text is often only possible by humans reviewing outputs or using LLMs to evaluate them. The former is laborious, slow, and expensive, while the latter often fails to evaluate the outputs correctly. For LLM evaluations to work properly, one needs to prompt engineer them; i.e., they require their own optimization process.

# **🚀 The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82145&key=user_uploads/501039/b7c1f4c7-b654-40e6-9e1d-84ab93f4ad5f)

The best [LLM evals](https://joschkabraun.com) are adapted to your particular business use case & data. We've developed a method for uploading human annotations (via CSV or using our [Annotation Queue](https://docs.parea.ai/manual-review/queue)) and bootstrapping an evaluation to mimic the annotations. To create a human-aligned eval, you need as few as 20 sample annotations. Using your new LLM eval is as easy as copying the code into your codebase or using it directly via Parea's API. Check out [our docs](https://docs.parea.ai/manual-review/bootstrapped-eval) to see the complete workflow.

# **🙏 Our Ask**

* **Get started** on [**our free tier,**](https://app.parea.ai/sign-up) or [**book a chat**](https://calendly.com/parea-ai/chat) to discuss how we can help you evaluate your AI app!
* **Support our** [**launch** **tweet**](https://x.com/JoschkaBraun/status/1812884216444510233) and follow us on [**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/parea-ai/) and [**Twitter**](https://x.com/PareaAI)

We provide debugging, testing, evaluation, and monitoring in one unified platform. These capabilities help developers get visibility into LLM responses, quickly test and optimize prompts, and ensure customers get the best user experience.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73431&key=user_uploads/699950/7cd2fa60-436e-46c0-b266-b88f3fd66b8c)

### 🤔 **The Problem**

LLMs hold infinite promise, but translating this potential into practical applications can be complex. Crafting precise prompts or building effective chains, tracking their performance, and optimizing them currently involves a disparate array of tools and a steep learning curve, leading to decreased productivity and increased time to market. This trial-and-error process can become taxing; in the words of one of our customers, **"reading 1000s of words from ChatGPT outputs a day takes the fun out of building**.**"**

### 💡 **The Solution**

Parea was conceived to streamline this journey by simplifying the entire process of creating and managing LLM-powered systems. Our intuitive UI enables developers to **debug and test** their **prompts/chains**, offering deep visibility into the best-performing changes that dramatically improve LLM responses. The built-in Lab module lets you **compare various prompts, models, and parameter configurations side by side**, transforming rigorous testing into an insightful and fun task. Post-deployment, our robust **API ensures you have comprehensive analytics**, performance insights, and a complete tracking system for optimizing your application to excel in delivering user experiences.

### 🚀 **Who is it for:**

Parea is for developers, AI enthusiasts, and organizations with a vision to leverage the power of LLMs. Whether you're a small team working on an LLM-driven product or a large company developing complex LLM-powered applications, **Parea simplifies the process and accelerates your time-to-productivity**.

### 🎉 **Meet the Parea team**

Joel and Joschka met in New York City and bonded over philosophy, learning, and of course, start-ups!

Joel is a true Renaissance man. His quest has led him from a published microbiology researcher to International Politics at the Council of Foreign Relations, to learning Russian in Moscow, working on >$100B of M&A deals at J.P Morgan, and most recently honing his self-taught coding skills as a SWE at Lyft. With Parea AI, he's committed to enhancing the productivity of every AI builder.

[Joschka](https://joschkabraun.com) is our Wunderkind. He published a paper in the highest-ranked Journal for Number Theory at age 17, graduated college at 19, took a gap year to do Kung Fu in China, then completed his Master's at NYU as a Fulbright scholar. Joschka spent the last 3 years on the AI/ML frontline doing computer vision at Covera Health, and semantic search & LLMs at Jina. Parea was born to tackle the issues he'd faced in debugging and building LLM applications like DevGPT.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73431&key=user_uploads/699950/4bdf0da2-6bfd-4139-8f0c-ea7e826fd062)

We invite you to explore [Parea’s](https://www.parea.ai?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_yc2&utm_content=cta) capabilities for your LLM solution and join our welcoming community. launches.title: Nowadays AI: AI-Native Platform for Corporate Meetings & Events
launches.tagline: The AI-native platform that sources venues, negotiates contracts, and runs your entire corporate event, so your team just shows up
launches.body:
Hey everyone!! We're Anna and Amy, sisters, co-founders, and the people who used to manually call 20 hotels for a single offsite.

We launched Nowadays on YC S23 as an "AI copilot for event planning." Two years later, we want to show you what we actually built :)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/709549e5-8a04-4b5c-8557-76886ff145a0)

# **TL;DR**

Nowadays is the AI-native platform for corporate retreats and meetings. Tell us what you need: we handle venue sourcing, contract negotiation, room blocks, attendee logistics, and post-event reconciliation. Fortune 500 teams and fast-growing startups use Nowadays to run offsites they're proud of, without burning out their ops team.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/53908cc7-1f81-4c15-afe7-5e0f11b7ad59)

# **The Problem**

Planning a corporate offsite is a second job nobody signed up for.

Your EA or ops lead spends weeks cold-emailing hotels, chasing RFPs, deciphering hotel contracts, and manually tracking room blocks in spreadsheets, only to do it all over again next quarter.

The vendors in this space are slow and expensive. Many of our customers have said the same thing: "I got paired with a planner worse than myself."

The result: overpriced venues, cancellation penalties nobody caught, and an ops team that's exhausted before the event even starts. And for most enterprises, 65% of meeting spend is completely unmanaged, buried in expense reports, booked by admins outside any system.

# **Our Solution**

Nowadays replaces the entire event planning stack with one AI-native platform, backed by a team that actually executes on your behalf. You tell us what you need. We handle the rest. Your team just shows up.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/67abf2bb-7640-4684-9bbf-c2bfb3a85d4a)

## **1. AI-powered venue sourcing**

Describe your event, dates, headcount, vibe, budget, and we generate a curated shortlist of venues with proposals in 24 hours, not weeks. We have relationships with 400K+ hotels globally and we're a certified IATA travel agency.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/cedeb56d-e591-4eed-a1f6-b75d1eabf9b5)

## **2. Contract negotiation, handled**

We negotiate directly with venues on your behalf, pushing on room rates, F&B minimums, attrition clauses, and cancellation terms. Our AI knows market rates from thousands of events and pushes back when hotels overcharge. Clients routinely save 20-30% vs. going direct.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/1156b34d-e9b9-4e1d-bc9a-7736a13901a9)

## **3. Exclusive rates**

We aggregate demand across all our clients to secure rates individual companies can't get on their own.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/592bb426-c3e7-4457-ab13-860504f2fc0e)

## **4. End-to-end logistics**

Room blocks, cutoff dates, rooming lists, supplier coordination, tracked in one place, managed by us. Nothing falls through the cracks while you're onsite.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/49563edb-1c99-4cc1-afbd-d590b691258f)

## **5. Attendee registration and logistics**

Custom registration forms, dietary needs, t-shirt sizes, room assignments, all in the platform. Your ops lead is not managing 12 spreadsheets.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/302d0f5a-5d1c-4b01-8cdc-32bffe7d01e8)

## **6. Expert support**

Every client gets a dedicated Nowadays partner who knows your program, your preferences, and your budget. Our AI acts, and when you need a human, we're there.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/2afea73a-7a20-4209-b1b7-e2ded68d6a13)

## **7. Post-event reconciliation**

We audit the final folio, catch billing errors, and close the loop financially. No more surprise charges two weeks after everyone's home.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/836fcdff-8837-4754-b447-cda95c651c11)

## **Why we're different**

Every competitor you've heard of bolted AI onto infrastructure built decades ago. We built around AI from day one, which is why a small team can do at scale what legacy platforms need armies of account managers to do.

Our AI calls venues in 22 languages, parses 50-page proposals into clean apples-to-apples comparisons, and routes every meeting through approval workflows, including the small ones EAs used to book on their own.

One Fortune 500 VP uncovered $18M in previously unmanaged meeting spend just by turning Nowadays on.

# **Use Cases**

* Quarterly offsites: for remote-first teams who need to meet all their new employees
* Leadership retreats: for executive teams running strategic planning sessions
* Sales kickoffs: with complex AV, F&B, and multi-day programming needs
* International group travel: we handle the complexity of multi-country logistics end to end

# **Where We Are Now**

We work with companies ranging from ones planning one epic kickoff a year to ones running thousands of meetings through the platform annually. Clients include Google, Airbnb, BlackRock, Anthropic, Pylon, and Mintlify.

We've run retreats from San Diego to Thailand, from 20-person leadership offsites to 500+ person company kickoffs.

We won both judges' choice and people's choice at Business Travel Show America 2025 and Business Travel Show APAC 2026, the two biggest innovation competitions in corporate travel.

# **Why Now**

Corporate travel spend is back and growing. But the infrastructure for planning events hasn't caught up. Legacy travel companies are slow, opaque, and not built for the modern distributed workforce. We're rebuilding this from scratch with AI at the core and a team that treats every event like it's our own.

# **We're growing!!**

We're hiring across the board for founding team members, engineers, operators, and account executives who want to work on a problem that's genuinely hard and unsolved, with a really fun team in San Francisco.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/6174eee6-ebce-4c88-8465-b443a7584c55)

See open roles: [nowadays.ai/careers](https://nowadays.ai/careers)

# **Get started**

Book a call: [meetings-na2.hubspot.com/amy-yan](http://meetings-na2.hubspot.com/amy-yan)

Email us: [events@nowadays.ai](mailto:events@nowadays.ai)

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re Dawson and Ethan, the founders of Letterbook.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99773&key=user_uploads/1399924/882cde5c-ce40-4fa9-ac07-a8b8104f3fa9)

## The Problem

We grew our last product, Martin (an AI personal assistant), to 100,000 users. At one point, we'd get 50 customer support tickets every day, across email and help forms:

* "How do I use this feature?"
* "Can I get a refund?"
* "I can't log into my account."

I had no choice but to hire a virtual assistant in the Philippines to reply to users and solve billing issues. I had to use Zendesk to manage tickets, which was built 20 years ago and designed for a VP of Support, not a founder.

## The Solution

None of this made sense, so we built our own modern, AI-native support platform.

Letterbook integrates with your database, knowledge base, and Stripe, and our AI auto-prepares resolutions to every ticket. All you have to do is review and send.

Watch our launch video: <https://youtu.be/S1vNoMTcKoI?si=sFwRk9Hpu95ibeqm>

## Results

We’ve already replaced Intercom, Zendesk, Zohodesk, Helpscout, and Freshdesk for many fast-growing companies in YC. 

One founder said:

> The AI drafts save us so much time, and it gets better over time without us doing anything (it learns from our past emails). When we have to make changes to the draft, the CMD+k feature is a game changer and allows us to fine-tune the response without copying and pasting the entire thread to ChatGPT.

## Try it for free

Sign up at <https://letterbook.ai>!

Start resolving tickets in 3 easy steps:

1. Connect your [support@yourdomain.com](mailto:support@yourdomain.com) inbox.
2. Connect your database and/or Stripe by pasting a restricted API key in Letterbook.
3. Review the first draft and send it!

Unlike Zendesk/Freshdesk/Zohodesk, which takes days to set up (a friend literally hired a consultant to teach him), Letterbook takes 5 mins. And if you need help, you better believe we have top-notch customer support!

You can book a call anytime at [letterbook.ai](http://letterbook.ai), or email me at [dawson@letterbook.ai](mailto:dawson@letterbook.ai).

launches.body:
Hi! We’re building [Tile](https://tile.sh/).

### **About Us**

[Jenica](https://linkedin.com/in/jenica-zhong) and [Jessica](https://linkedin.com/in/jfang707) have collectively spent 9 years data wrangling at Palantir. We have built AI models and analytics products for both commercial enterprise and defense customers. Before Palantir, Jenica studied Math/CS at Harvard, and Jessica studied CS at MIT.

### **Problem**

**1\.   SQL is verbose and hard to use for exploratory data analysis**

Data analysis is an iterative and investigative process. While SQL remains the most powerful language for working with data, SQL syntax results in long code blocks that are unforgiving when trying to quickly explore data.

**2\. Plain english is good for describing a high level query, but not the right UI for refinement**

AI has been an incredible technology for fetching the right general data and columns on a well-defined and metadata-rich semantic layer. However, analysts must write long descriptive sentences to refine the query.

### **Solution**

**Tile allows anyone to explore and investigate their data in modularized steps without the clunky syntax of SQL.**

Once the insight is found, convert your tiles to a SQL block so you still have the robustness of code when building reports to share this insight with others.

**Vision: The future is AI-enabled data analysis and report building. However, for it to work, explainability will be key. Tile will allow AI to show its work with step-by-step tiles and allow end users to fine-tune its responses.**

**Demo: Learn how Dwight can use Tile to explore Dunder Mifflin’s transactions data**

<https://youtu.be/vRRoolP3jG0>

### **Try Tile with your data**

[Sign up for a free 14 day trial](https://www.tile.sh/free-trial-sign-up) using Tile with your data! Reach out to [jenica@tile.sh](mailto:jenica@tile.sh) for specific questions.

launches.tagline: We allow more than 250 companies to easily purchase and manage their mobile lines while reducing costs.
launches.body:
We're [Artur](https://linkedin.com/in/arturnegrao), [Lucas](https://linkedin.com/in/lucas-rosa-3080b43b), [Hudo](https://linkedin.com/in/hudo-assenco), and [Duda](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mariaeduardakumlehn/), the team behind [Salvy](https://www.salvy.com.br). We're **simplifying mobile and IT management for businesses**. Our mission is to cut through the chaos of telecom and IT services in Brazil.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78582&key=user_uploads/928768/83c1a053-91c7-452f-98f5-394c85819498)

# **The Problem**

Companies in Brazil are tangled in complex telecom contracts and lost in inefficiencies. It's a universal headache, especially for businesses scaling up. That's where we step in.

### Customer Pains

1. **Cost inefficiency.** Companies use only 30% of what they purchase and around 20% of mobile lines are unused.
2. **No transparency.** Companies don't know who is using it, how much they are using and for what.
3. **Companies have no autonomy to manage their lines.** The mobile operators offer a very limited platform, increasing the need for customer service.
4. **Awful customer service.** Incumbents provide low autonomy customer service that leaves customers with no effective help.
5. **Confusing payments.** Invoices are long and confusing. Big companies have to hire consultants to understand how much they are paying. Some customers have over 120 telecom invoices a month.

# **Our Solution**

Salvy simplifies how companies **purchase and manage mobile telecom, turning it into SaaS**. Our platform provides a transparent, efficient way to handle mobile lines and IT demands (such as inventory management), minus the traditional hurdles.

We use AI to read telecom invoices and help companies migrate to Salvy. In just over a year, we've acquired +250 companies and have a 322% NDR with a 0,2% churn.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Io7iavc7qc0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Io7iavc7qc0&t=2s)

### **Our Vision**

Our goal is to be the **one-stop-shop solution for all things IT**, much like Rippling IT Cloud. We're using telco as a gateway to provide other solutions such as inventory and SaaS management, using AI to empower these solutions with speed and efficiency. We believe in three strategies:

1. Retention is inherent in B2B mobile telecom when you do a good job and there are no loyalty contracts.
2. Mobile telco works as the gateway to other IT solutions for mid-sized companies
3. If you can work as a one-stop-shop software for IT, you can build a really successful business.

Thank you for getting to know more about us and feel free to [reach out to us](mailto:artur@salvy.com.br) for more details!

launches.tagline: AI that runs fleet ops end-to-end, unlocking revenue and curbing costs.
launches.body:
**We manage 10,000+ vehicles for Fortune 500 companies with a team of 10.**

8 months ago, we scrapped our original model and rebuilt Carma as an AI-native operating system for fleet operations.

Since then, every metric has compounded.

⸻

**The problem**

Fleet maintenance is the #1 cost for companies that run vehicles.

And it’s still managed with:

* 15+ disconnected tools
* spreadsheets
* phone calls

Million-dollar decisions happen daily.

Made by people who:

* aren’t automotive experts
* aren’t incentivized on cost

So they approve everything.

Management can’t keep up. The problem requires deep technical context. It gets ignored.

As fleets grow, complexity snowballs.

The double-effect is vicious:

Vehicle uptime drops while costs spiral.

Margins bleed heavily.

⸻

**Why incumbents fail**

The incumbent software providers are 30+ year-old leasing companies.

They make money when fleets replace vehicles more often.

So real optimization works against them.

Their software reflects it:

* system of record
* not system of intelligence

_In reality:_ glorified Google Drive with manual data entry.

No automation. No decisions. No leverage.

⸻

**What we built**

Carma replaces the entire stack.

Our AI system, Neo, runs fleet operations end-to-end:

* automates all repetitive daily workflows
* replaces all manual labor
* replaces all fragmented software

And makes optimal decisions:

* verifies pricing

**💰Referral Opportunity:** We’re offering $100 in cash for every vehicle onboarded through a warm referral to a new client. 500 vehicles = $50,000 cash referral bonus. In addition, the referred fleet receives a 25% discount on their Carma subscription fees for their first 12 months.

**🤝 [Join Carma Now](https://www.joincarma.com/)**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76596&key=user_uploads/1377569/ff0b49ed-15b5-4336-89fb-fef7553f940a)

We are also hiring top-caliber full-stack software engineers and account executives – apply [**HERE**](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/carma/jobs) today.

**👀 [See How Carma Works](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hx7fTYv3GBw)**

**😡The Problem: Fleets HATE getting vehicle repair!**

It’s a time-draining hassle to get vehicle repair for fleets – a lack of price transparency makes U.S. fleets lose $37 billion each year due to improper or unnecessary vehicle repairs. Based on recent industry statistics, service centers overcharge fleets 85% of the time, leaving fleets overpaying an average of 68% more than what they actually should based on the fair cost of service. The worst part: there’s not much the average fleet management team can do – most fleets rely on minimal spares and don’t have the time to price shop for quotes. 80% of fleet managers don’t know what fair auto repair pricing looks like for non-routine repairs.

**💲The Solution: Carma**

Carma gets fleets prioritized same-day service offers with guaranteed, locked-in pricing. Fleet managers request any service they need through Carma, which we send to our highly rated and vetted local service center Partner Centers, who respond with real-time offers. Fleet can compare multiple same-day service offers in just 60 seconds or less. Carma handles the transaction with zero fees – no marked-up prices or “convenience” charges – you pay the service center’s in-store price or better.

Fleets save upwards of 50% when they use Carma vs. the median price for the same service in their zip code. It takes just 30 seconds to add a car to your profile and request service.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76596&key=user_uploads/1377569/179a2ad1-4d43-4195-8951-dcba9afe1f1c)

We are setting a new standard in automotive service to make pricing transparent and the entire process hassle-free.

Carma was founded by a team of automotive experts with deep technical domain expertise from the most prominent industry leaders, with a combined 120+ years of experience in the automotive service industry:

He has worked on over $60B of cumulative transactions for notable corporate clients such as Carvana, Honeywell Transportation Systems, and various stakeholder affiliates of Hertz Rent-A-Car. Graduate of Washington University in St. Louis.

Suleyman studied biology and chemistry with an emphasis in biomedical science at the University of Missouri - Kansas City.

Our sales process is supercharged by personal introductions, so any fleets whose owners or operational managers who you know or could introduce us to would be **very valuable**.

For each vehicle onboarded through your warm referral to a new fleet client, we will wire you $100 in cash. 500 vehicles = $50,000 cash referral bonus. In addition, your referred fleet receives a 25% discount on their Carma subscription fees for their first 12 months.

launches.title: Toma, an AI Platform for the $2T Automotive Industry
launches.tagline: Toma is on a mission to build world-class communication and support tools for America's high ticket industries, starting with automotive.
launches.body:
### **Next-Gen Voice AI in a $2T Industry that Silicon Valley Overlooks**

We’re thrilled to share that Toma [**raised a $17M Series A**](https://techcrunch.com/2025/06/05/tomas-ai-voice-agents-have-taken-off-at-car-dealerships-and-attracted-funding-from-a16z/), led by **Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)**, who chose us after vetting every voice AI company in automotive. The wild part is that we got here through just word-of-mouth sales, without a sales team, and now power **hundreds of customers** across the U.S.

Since graduating from YC, we’ve gone knee-deep into a trillion-dollar industry historically neglected by Silicon Valley––automotive dealerships. We’ve spent half a year **living in them** to learn how they communicate with their customers, run their day-to-day operations, and provide both great and (usually) not-so-great customer experiences. To put it simply, **things are broken**.

So we built AI agents that fix it by:

* Deploying **personalized agents**
* **Automating inbound calls** with a low-latency, natural-sounding voice AI
* Running **outbound SMS** campaigns that generate new revenue
* **Deeply integrating** with automotive-specific software
* Offering **insights and reporting** into every AI/customer interaction
* Intelligently **alerting customers** when human intervention is needed

We’re now the **fastest-growing** AI platform in automotive, and we’re just getting started.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/65a56669-51b7-40ff-ad8e-4c443df5a09c)

### **From YC Hack Project to Must-Have AI Employee**

We started Toma as **two engineers** ([Monik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/monikp/) & [Anthony](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anthonykrivonos/)) who didn’t want to build another generic chatbot. We flew around the country, shadowing advisors in hot service bays, listening to call recordings, and mapping dealership workflows in Figma. We **wrote code inside dealerships** as bugs and feature ideas were discovered alongside our users.

We took a YC prototype and turned it into a real product. Today, dealerships such as [Martin Management Group](https://www.toma.com/resources/case-study/how-ai-doubled-operational-margins-for-martin-management-group) and [Middletown Honda](https://www.toma.com/resources/case-study/how-toma-helps-middletown-honda-save-100k-annually) rely on Toma to handle **tens of thousands of calls** monthly. Calls that were previously missing entirely or requiring thousands of dollars to outsource to call centers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/3a60abaf-e5fd-437a-8b4c-f38d911f215e)

### **The Results Are Wild**

* **Martin Management Group:** 9,000 service appointments booked in 90 days. $2M+ in revenue. 40% reduction in BDC workload.
* **Middletown Honda:** 53% of inbound calls handled by AI. $100K+ saved annually. Zero missed calls during recall events.
* **Nationwide:** Over 1 million call minutes handled by Toma since launch. Hundreds of thousands of hours of human time saved.
* **Growth:** Surpassed 7-figures in ARR in less than one year while approaching 8 figures with over 100 dealerships using Toma across the U.S.

The best part is that vehicle owners love it, dealers love it, and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) love it because **Toma works very well**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/85178e79-dde7-4ec7-b19e-b28691d601a4)

### **Why This Industry Matters (and Why It’s Underserved)**

Cars are essential to how Americans live, work, and move, and they’re getting older. The average vehicle on the road is 12.6 years old. That means **more maintenance, more service calls, and more pressure** on dealerships to deliver better experiences.

Silicon Valley has historically **ignored this space**. It’s messy, full of edge cases, and utilizes antiquated software, requiring a deep understanding of real-world operations. **That’s where we thrive.** We see a gold rush in how AI can revolutionize the automotive retail industry.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/e94c67ce-14f4-4b8a-8648-3b105052b1d9)

### **Why This Industry is Just the Beginning**

**Automotive** is one of many high-ticket, operationally complex industries in the U.S.—alongside insurance, home services, logistics, and healthcare—where communication is still largely **manual**, software is **legacy**, and workflows are deeply **idiosyncratic**.

These industries are slow-moving but massive, with billions of dollars lost every year due to inefficiencies. While we’re laser-focused on fixing communication in dealerships, Toma is **building the horizontal foundation for deploying production-grade AI assistants** across every high-value, high-friction service industry. We believe the future of operations will be AI-augmented, and we’re laying the rails.

### **The Tech**

**In-house**, we have built:

* A SOTA **voice AI orchestration** pipeline
* **Dynamic integration platform** for connecting to legacy software
* Production-grade **agentic workflow** engine
* **Agent evaluation** pipelines
* **Prompt management** tools that allow us to support hundreds of customers as a 3-person ops team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/2c4115f8-a2bf-433b-b7f3-30f4fa6ca0c3)

### **Our Culture: Builders First, Always**

Toma was **built by engineers**, and we hire technically-minded people across all responsibilities. We move quickly, fix things, and build from the ground up. We care deeply about real-world impact and meticulous attention to detail.

We’re backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, Scale Angels, Flex Capital, Holman Automotive, and more. But more than anything, we’re backed by many of our own dealerships and their staff, who trust us to communicate with their customers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/9eeaaa4c-ba17-4927-82b9-230c362a3684)

### **Who We're Looking For**

You might be a fit if you:

* Want to build **cutting-edge AI features** and work on SOTA everything
* Are **disillusioned by AI slop** products and want to solve real-world problems
* Want **excessive ownership** of critical systems and infrastructure
* Have a **high bar of excellence** and want to work with people who match your energy

If you’re curious, please join us in building the future of AI-powered automotive retail operations. We’re a small team, but we punch above our weight and are having a blast doing it.

👉 [www.toma.com/jobs](http://www.toma.com/jobs)

launches.title: 🪄 Toma automates your phone calls with AI ✨
launches.tagline: Voice AI Agents to handle phone calls and perform tasks for your business
launches.body:
### **TLDR;**

[**Toma**](https://toma.so/) offers AI Agents that can autonomously handle phone calls for your business.

🗣️ A natural-sounding voice experience over the phone\
🪄 A simple way to design call flows and manage AI agents\
🧩 Easy integration into your existing software to pull information and perform tasks on/off call

Toma is live and automating calls for companies in industries ranging from healthcare to automotive.

### **Problem**

Customers call businesses expecting a superior experience over other channels. Instead, they have to put up with:

❌ Long wait times\
❌ Repeated transfers to different agents without any context\
❌ Robotic call flows (read: Press 1 for English.. Sorry.. I didn’t catch that... Let me repeat the options)

Businesses find phone call operations **labor-intensive**, **expensive**, **inconsistent in quality**, and **hard to scale**.

The main challenges for businesses include:

* Training agents
* Ensuring quality and consistency across calls
* Access control & compliance

### **Our Solution:** [**Toma**](https://toma.so/)

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p5SvyAHtyyU**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p5SvyAHtyyU)

* **Realistic call experience**: customizable human-like voices with low latency tested in noisy, real-world environments
* **Integrations**: integrate with your CRM, knowledge bases, and third-party software to pull and push data
* **Observability**: monitor calls with recordings, summaries, and granular analytics
* **Live 24/7**: always on, no breaks
* **Transfer**: intelligently transfer to humans if needed

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77697&key=user_uploads/92912/75ed5b30-3ec8-4de2-a6af-9d53e9d84c7e)

### **TEAM**

We’re Monik & Anthony. We’re best friends who have worked together and known each other for many years.

We believe that voice will be the best way for consumers to interact with AI in the future. The ubiquity of phones, advancements in AI, and the friction of traditional interactive voice systems have set the industry up for disruption.

We have extensive experience building large-scale customer messaging software, LLM applications, and conversational AI working at Scale, Uber, Lyft, and Braze, and we believe we can make the experience 10x better.

### **Asks:**

* If your business makes or receives phone calls, please set up a call with us [**here**](https://www.toma.so/contact) if you’d like to explore automation
* Intros to any businesses that run their own call centers or outsource those operations (you can reach us at [founders@toma.so](mailto:founders@toma.so))

launches.title: CommodityAI — The shipment management platform for commodity traders
launches.tagline: Meet CommodityAI, the easiest way for commodity traders to manage shipments
launches.body:
Hi everyone! We’re [Philip](https://linkedin.com/in/philipkoenig), [Kyle](https://linkedin.com/in/kyle-manuel-franz-7a4351a8), and [Daniel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dcervoni/) from [CommodityAI](https://commodityai.io/). We are building a platform for commodity traders to manage their shipments.

**tl;dr** CommodityAI makes it easy for commodity trading companies to manage their shipments. One of the largest sugar traders uses our product to classify over a million documents, extract relevant fields from them, and organize them by shipment. They also use us to execute shipment-related workflows, like sending shipment status updates and generating vessel nominations.

# **The Problem**

Shipping commodities requires a company to manage \~200 processes and over 50 documents. Now imagine you're managing thousands of shipments a month, and tens of thousands in a year. As a result, a trading company’s workforce spends \~70% of their day on admin and 40% of operating costs are allocated to labor. Almost all of our customer calls have had one thing in common: the trader or operations person can recall a time in the past 6 months when a document or process error resulted in the firm losing hundreds of thousands of dollars.

These processes also differ between customers. In other words, no 2 customers run their commodity trading operations the exact same way. This makes it difficult to build a one-size-fits-all solution without being intimately familiar with the space and the nuances of these shipments.

# **The Solution**

We’ve built AI, automation, and collaborative tools built specifically for commodities trading. Our customers use CommodityAI to manage thousands of shipments and process millions of shipment-related documents. This includes classifying them, extracting relevant fields, and organizing them. They also use our platform to automate a series of time-consuming, related tasks that they do in their day-to-day, such as tracking vessels, generating vessel nominations, and sending real-time updates to their counterparty.

**Document Processing Workflow: Classify, Extract data, create shipment**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79344&key=user_uploads/1800705/47492cb6-5514-42b8-97ea-03ad19cad07e)

**Track and Send Shipment Status Updates**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79344&key=user_uploads/1800705/524a9171-3d63-42a0-8a14-d5360ecda593)

Our goal is to ultimately take the number of manual processes within a commodities shipment down to 0, transforming the way commodity trading companies manage their operations.

# **Ask**

We know there aren’t too many commodity trading companies probably checking YC every day, but we do know many founders worked as traders or know traders from previous work experience! We’d be extremely grateful for any introductions to potential customers or investors =).

launches.body:
**🙈 TL:DR:** Companies selling physical products spend a fortune on accounting and are still left with incorrect financials because of inventory related complications. We fix that.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82712&key=user_uploads/505183/a2949d25-3407-403c-88d4-f6f9beff9ce7)

🥵 **PROBLEM**: Companies selling physical products struggle with accounting and inventory operations. Current bookkeeping methods rely heavily on manual input and are often disconnected from accurate inventory data. This leads to mistakes in important financial figures like cost of goods sold (COGS), inventory value, margins, and cash flow. As a result, businesses spend a lot of time and money only to gain an inaccurate picture of their financial health. These inaccuracies lead to poor budgeting decisions, loan rejections, failed fundraising, non-compliance, and frequent cash flow crises.

😍 **OUR SOLUTION:** A powerful AI accounting agent built specifically for companies selling physical products.

Our platform automates bookkeeping and completes a variety of crucial product operations tasks such as calculating COGS, optimizing POs, and conducting contribution margin analysis with only a few clicks.

All financial and inventory data is connected and written back to QBO or your ERP, eliminating financial statement errors, saving dozens of hours per month, and thousands on accounting costs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82712&key=user_uploads/505183/56544b6d-0310-4c0e-a398-09bdb3945f94)

💡 **THE INSPIRATION:** As the founder of Robin Golf, [Peter](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marler/) encountered this problem frequently. Doing the financials required an expensive team and the books were always inexplicably wrong. As as a result, the company was underwritten for debt and equity incorrectly, wasn’t able to make proper budgeting decisions, couldn’t forecast inventory needs, couldn’t optimize channel mix, and was blindsided by cash shortfalls.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82712&key=user_uploads/505183/46551b06-df3e-4d8c-bc8e-46a92a333bf8)

Hi, we’re Darius and Asa. We're friends, dads, go-karting rivals, and the cofounders of [Genie](https://www.Genie.gg) — the best AI sidekick for kids. Genie is a conversational AI that encourages creative play and guides kids through the Genieverse, the future of games, media, and social for kids.

Visit us at: [www.Genie.gg](http://www.Genie.gg)

**The Genie Team**

[Asa](https://www.linkedin.com/in/asamiller/) and [Darius](http://linkedin.com/in/dariusmonsef) previously cofounded [BraveCare.com](http://BraveCare.com) (YC S19), which raised $40M in funding and enabled more than 50k urgent care visits for kids who were sick or injured— during the pandemic and the recovery years— all while delivering a care experience that maintained a nearly 5-Star score across thousands of reviews.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82522&key=user_uploads/32175/b55dcc84-b2d8-4620-a77f-620f8f66d3ff)

**Our vision for a better internet for kids**

As a father, I want to protect my kids at all times and everywhere they go in the world, and in reality, I can’t. But I can build an AI that keeps them safe everywhere they go online and create a “digital Disneyland” for them to play, explore, and connect in.

Like Jarvis to Ironman, Sox to Buzz Lightyear, or Baymax to Hiro, a child is the hero of their own story, and we’re building them the ultimate sidekick. An AI buddy that has their back in the online world, encourages creative play and helps them learn about anything, at any time, in an age-appropriate way.

Soon, hundreds of millions of kids across the globe will connect on the next platform that’s foundationally powered by AI. We’ve seen it coming for a while, and we’re already building that new space… the Genieverse!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82522&key=user_uploads/32175/366ff304-4c16-476d-b7ae-cb271a5249c9)

**Do something fun with Genie today**

**Create**\
Genie is an always-kind, supportive & friendly AI agent that can co-create free-form generative art with kids, and they can create thru other art modes like the “Crazy Food Lab” or “Muppet Monsters.”

**Play**\
Genie can also build incredibly imaginative story worlds where kids decide what happens next or play logic puzzles or word games designed to spark kids’ creative and critical thinking. Genie also knows that kids should have time off of their screens and be active out in the world. When there is available screen time, we built Genie to be engaging and creative.

**Learn**\
The internet is an incredible wealth of knowledge and information, but browsers are binary about whether a kid has access to everything… or nothing. Genie is a safe resource for kids who are curious about the world around them. Sometimes a trusted adult isn’t available to ask, or kids feel weird about asking, so Genie makes sure that tricky questions are answered in kind and age-appropriate ways.

We’ve handled tasks such as image labeling, invoice extraction, and PDF report parsing — with greater accuracy and speed than traditional BPOs or off-the-shelf software solutions. 

**Our team**

[Paulo Bautista](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paulobautista/) was the first employee and Head of Business Operations at Ninja Van in the Philippines, where he managed a team of several hundred delivery couriers and grew the business to 8 figures in annual revenue. Before YC, he ran an 800-person call center as the Director of Operations and Strategy for a late-stage restaurant tech startup. Paulo studied Business Economics at the University of the Philippines and holds an MBA from Harvard Business School.

**Why are we building Callback?**

Hey 👋 I’m Robert, founder of Stormy.

We’re building Stormy because influencer marketing is still spreadsheets, manual DMs, and endless negotiations with influencers. In a world of “AI SDRs,” you should be able to describe your campaign once and have the AI agent just work for you while you sleep. Growing your business while you focus on the tech.

We recently won **Product Hunt Product of the Day**, and YC founders + agencies are already using Stormy to run micro- and nano-influencer campaigns end-to-end.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jK_8i8Wd0iQ&t=1s

### How does it work?

Type a brief; Stormy handles the pipeline:

1. **Describe your ideal creators**\
   “US-based AI YouTubers talking about agents, 10–100k subs” → Stormy searches YouTube & TikTok, podcasts, etc., and verifies each match.
2. **One-click contacts**\
   Grab real emails in bulk (bio, site, press pages) and enrich profiles.
3. **AI Negotiator**\
   Connect your Gmail and TikTok account to personalize outreach, automatic follow-ups, price extraction, and counter-offers within your budget guardrails—logged to a lightweight CRM.
4. **Close & track**\
   Mark deals, export assets, and keep everything in one place (performance tracking integrations coming).

### Who’s it for?

* **Founders/In-house Growth** at AI & consumer apps who want predictable creator acquisition
* **Agencies** running lots of small collabs (micro/nano) and are sick of manual workflows
* **Creators/brands** who need a simple way to scale outreach without scaling headcount

### Why now?

Creator supply is exploding; attention is fragmented. Winning brands are those that can operationalize many small deals, fast. Stormy turns the “thousand tiny tasks” of influencer ops into a clean, automated flow.

### What’s next?

* **Promote UGC with TikTok Ads** — Spark/allowlisting in one click with budget guardrails and auto-variants.
* **Payments & Tracking** — creator payouts, contracts/usage windows, and performance attribution (UTM, Appsflyer, PostHog) per asset.
* **Unified Influencer → Performance CRM** — one pipeline from discovery & negotiation to ROAS/LTV.
* **Always-on Outreach (“Auto-campaigns”)** — human-in-the-loop sequences to keep the funnel full.
* **Light UGC Workflows** — simple briefs and clip collection (no heavy studio), with templates and QA for consistency.

Questions—or interested in learning more? Email [**robert@stormy.ai**](mailto:robert@stormy.ai)

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Across the United States, we spend $700B/year on maintaining homes. Half the cost of any given home service is attributed to compensating the work it took just to coordinate that job. We believe that can and should be solved for. Owners need to (and prefer to) remain focused on “the real work” instead of non-value driving efforts. Businesses in this industry provide an essential service to our economy - they maintain our supply of housing - but they are operated in an incredibly manual and wasteful way. We solve that with AI receptionists that can coordinate with each of the parties at every stage in the process. The receptionists can then work with our AI estimators to provide quotes, and together they can use our CRM, project management, and payment solutions to store updates and take action throughout the process.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: There are many elements that contribute to the inflated cost of housing and they impact everyone from the homeless, to renters, to homeowners, and investors. An often-overlooked contributor to this cost is the high opEx in owning and maintaining a home. The most wasteful element of that expenditure is not materials or labor - it is compensating businesses for their administrative work (finding, quoting, managing, and coordinating jobs). My dream is to cut out those inefficiencies by bringing true automation to the home service industry. In doing so, we as a society can take a step towards better, more accessible housing.

launches.title: Drillbit 🧰 Handling office work for residential contractors
launches.tagline: Your contractor's AI-powered back office.
launches.body:
### **\~TLDR\~**

Residential contractors are drowning in office work that has nothing to do with their core business. [**Drillbit**](https://www.drillbit.com) automates all of it. We use AI receptionists and an LLM based quoting tool on top of our own CRM to entirely manage jobs from lead, to quote, to scheduling, to staffing, and finally payment.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82558&key=user_uploads/1549700/acbc535d-4709-4176-a54f-8fe50c23a170)

### **Problem🚨**

Residential contractors provide a critical service to our economy: building and maintaining the supply of housing. Unfortunately, those businesses are still operated in an incredibly manual way. Across the U.S., we spend about $675B/year on simple home maintenance. A significant portion of that cost is attributed to the office work involved with finding, coordinating, and managing those small jobs. Business owners need to (and prefer to) remain focused on the real work instead of non-value-driving efforts.

### **Solution 🏗️**

[**Drillbit**](https://www.drillbit.com) allows contractors to be entirely hands-off, enabling them to focus 100% of their time on their core business. We have built AI receptionists that can coordinate with businesses and homeowners at every stage in the process. The receptionists then work with our AI estimators to provide quotes. Together, they are able to use our CRM, project management, and payment solutions to store updates and take action throughout the process.

### **Landscape ⛰️**

Platforms that have come before us were able to move service business operations from texting and emailing over to CRMs and project management solutions, but they suffer from massive churn rates. Owners we have spoken with have consistently voiced the feeling that they were “babysitting” the tool. All of that “homework” they had to do entirely undermined the value of the solution in their eyes, and so, most users would abandon the platform. Rather than expecting our users to change their behavior - ie. start using technology that they would rather not be interacting with - we have met them where they are by handling the job coordination in a way that feels familiar to them: offering the ability to talk to your “employees” on the phone like you would a real person, and having those “employees” be able to engage with homeowners over the phone like real people would too.

### **Team 👷👷‍♂️**

[**Alex**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aseutin) (Stanford CS / AI) spent the first part of his career developing applied AI solutions at SpaceX, Apple, and Rivian. After some time developing robots for industrial construction projects, Alex found a passion for hands-on work and spent a few years renovating old homes and airstreams. During that time, Alex became intimately familiar with the pain points in the construction and home service industries and realized how much of a need there was for better, more automated software. At that point, he decided to merge his passions and set out to build [**Drillbit**](https://www.drillbit.com) to support the folks maintaining America's housing.

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=82558&key=user_uploads/1549700/69e0cd13-9458-4048-b7b6-62938dffa061)

### **Ask 🙏**

* [**Alex’s LinkedIn Page**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aseutin/)

Hi YC community!

Team Intryc (S24) here and excited to show you the second and most upgraded iteration of our product, already used by billion dollar companies like [Deel.com](http://Deel.com) and Blueground as well as hypergrowth startups like Fyxer AI and Factorial.

| The Team |

For those who don’t know us yet, our team spent 8+ years in the CX space. We’ve solved support tickets, managed accounts, built cross-country/continent teams and created entire playbooks and processes of how world-class CX teams should interact and support customers across the globe in our previous employers at Revolut, Confluent, Navan, Meta, Amazon.

| The Problem |

Creating a culture of operational excellence, overachieving, and top performance is one of the toughest challenges every company and leadership team face.

Especially in CX, every customer interaction can make or break that customer trust and turn into a nightmare or opportunity. There’s two sides to this problem. Lack of visibility and time to action.

We solved the first half during our S24 batch when we released our AI QA tool for CX teams that allows companies to monitor up to 100% and the most important samples of their customer interactions. Moving onto the second half, CX and Learning & Development managers spend 15+ hours per week building performance improvement material, aligning resources, and ensuring agents, CSMs, and adjacent CS Ops teams are well trained and prepared. Through role plays, shadowing, piecing together training material, reiterating, and updating the relevant resources - all critical activities yet still remain highly manual, unscalable, and more often than not outdated and simplistic. 2 out of 3 customers churn after a single negative support interaction. Training and coaching is more often than not limited, reactive, time-consuming, and inconsistent.

| The Solution |

Realistic Simulations: Agents practise on challenging, real-life scenarios (based on past tickets) in a safe environment. Low stakes, high gains!

Automated Scoring: Every interaction is measured against your org’s policies & playbooks, with unlimited tries and clear graduation paths. No more guesswork, team members get instant and clear feedback.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94385&key=user_uploads/1341483/db13b953-549f-4336-95a6-c394e5de273b)

Targeted Coaching: Managers instantly see who needs help and where, cutting wasted training time. Enough with one-size fits all, different people need help in different areas.\
\
Always Improving: Both new joiners and seasoned agents keep up-to-date with new products or processes effortlessly.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94385&key=user_uploads/1341483/68f1a2c1-1c0f-4b44-833b-4c4533e2d3a6)

Continuous monitoring and process improvement: All data points are collected in personalised dashboards and reports that create a virtuous cycle of improvement across the team while completely eliminating up to 80% of manual preparation work and continuous manual data gathering and reporting across the organisation. Systems over wishful thinking.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94385&key=user_uploads/1341483/3a7b12dc-7bf0-4904-9e84-ed0a38cd5517)

The first results on our early adopters show onboarding and training time reduced by up to 50%. Managers reclaim 12–15 hours per week.

Agents have a lot more visibility on their performance progress, don’t have to guess any more and continuously improve like having a personal coach in their pocket.

We’re excited for as many of you as possible to give this a try and share your feedback!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82343&key=user_uploads/89898/63e0ef63-8615-4520-b36e-bcabccfdad58)

**tl;dr**

[Intryc](https://intryc.com/) uses AI to automate Quality Assurance for customer support. **The Problem**

Quality assurance for customer support is vital in regulated sectors like banking and utilities. Millions of customer inquiries must be handled and evaluated consistently and accurately to avoid regulatory non-compliance and brand reputation damage. This process is typically run manually by internal teams that still rely on outdated systems or spreadsheets to review and evaluate customer interactions. Even the most efficient QA teams can evaluate less than 5% of total tickets, leaving millions of interactions unreviewed and risking regulatory compliance, reputation damage, and increased customer churn.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82343&key=user_uploads/1341483/44a793a2-2c70-4389-ab09-8970eaaf7e7a)

**The Solution**

Intryc’s AI-powered solution automates the manual, repetitive, and error-prone tasks of the QA process, integrates with knowledge bases and data sources, such as help desks and CRM systems, to streamline the entire process end-to-end and allows organisations to scale their Support QA, without the scaling costs!

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eqIx1bnzEGk>

**What Intryc offers:**

* **Automated Intelligent Sampling**
  * Automate your sampling and workload distribution to ensure an optimal ratio of QA specialists to sampled tickets, minimising idle QA time.
  * Create targeted customer ticket samples with AI based on sentiment, keywords, or other custom rules.
* **Dynamic Workload Distribution**
  * Create hybrid or fully automated AI evaluation workloads to double your team’s productivity.
* **Custom Scorecards and Unlimited Coverage**
  * Optimize your scorecards with customized criteria based on internal playbooks, knowledge bases, or evaluation repositories.
  * Score up to 100% of your tickets with AI without a single human involved, or try AI vs human A/B testing, and override AI evaluations when required.
  * Get AI-generated ticket and agent evaluation summaries.
* **Tailored Agent Coaching**
  * Get AI-generated summaries of underperforming agents based on scorecard ratings and provide tailored coaching to each agent.
* **Extensive reporting**
  * AI generated insights based on key topics, product areas, or customer service from your entire ticket base.
  * Real-time ticket evaluations and agent performance summaries for management.

**TL;DR:** Our AI-powered operating system enables brands and manufacturers to sell on all global e-commerce marketplaces. \
Using [omnidock](https://www.omnidock.com/), they sell through our local entities and pre-vetted marketplace accounts, as we act as their merchant of record. This increases their revenue by at least 20% immediately after using omnidock.

Expanding to new geographies and marketplaces is a massive growth opportunity for brands and manufacturers, but it's complex and resource-intensive

Global e-commerce marketplaces have varying requirements, are often gated, and demand multiple legal entities to operate. As a result, many merchants leave the potential untapped.

The marketplace landscape is more fragmented than ever. Since 2020 (COVID), alternative marketplaces in the US and EU are outgrowing generalists like Amazon and now account for over 40% of marketplace GMV in the US and 51% in the EU.

Additionally, manufacturers that work with us typically operate on production-focused ERPs like SAP. Integrating such ERPs into any marketplace is extremely expensive and takes months if not years.

# **Solution🚀**

**Brands simply plug into our operating system, and we:**

* Read & asses their catalog for marketplace eligibility [**✅**](https://emojiterra.com/de/weises-hakchen/)
* Modify their content via AI to meet marketplace-specific requirements (e.g., matching taxonomies for them) [**✅**](https://emojiterra.com/de/weises-hakchen/)
* Launch their catalog through our pre-vetted marketplace accounts & entities [**✅**](https://emojiterra.com/de/weises-hakchen/)

We handle all transactions on their behalf, removing the challenges and complexities of multi-marketplace selling.

**TLDR:** Every year, consumers miss out on more than **$50B** because they are not claiming the money they are entitled to. We built AI agents that claim it for them.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83836&key=user_uploads/1984796/7093e028-b7ff-4ac4-9942-f98c49b9d002)

# The Problem 🚩

When stuff you’ve already bought goes on sale or when flights you’ve booked are delayed, policies entitle you to money. But spotting these opportunities and claiming the cash you’re owed is time-consuming and confusing. Industries subject to such policies include retail, airlines, hotels, technology, and even the government.

# Our Solution 💸

We're building AI that connects to your email inbox to: scan your e-receipts, identify opportunities to get you dollars, and automatically claim them by contacting customer service via email, phone, forms, or chat.

We started by automating refunds in the shopping industry and have secured $6,650, growing **233% MoM**. With AI, we've been able to generalize that same automation to tackle refunds in the flight industry and the class-action lawsuit landscape. That’s when we understood why this had never been done before…

# Why now? 🚨

AI enables us, for the first time, to automatically:

1. **Reason about unstructured data at scale**
2. **Handle complex, nuanced customer service interactions**

 

Generalizing securing refunds from one industry to all industries turns each step of the process into an unstructured data processing problem. For example, having a parser that can only understand Cotsco receipts and a scraper that can only read the price from the Costco website is not enough anymore: you need a parser that can understand changing receipts from all enterprises and a scraper that can read information from any website. The ability to reason about unstructured data at scale replaces the rigid, static software, solving the issue.

### In short, PAP! represents an opportunity to finally realize the dream customer journey — sign up once, forget we exist, and earn money effortlessly.

# Our Team 👨‍👨‍👦

* [Weijie](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wjwang2/) (CTO) spent 6 years in e-commerce and was the lead infra engineer for Wish’s recommendation system, the product that fueled their IPO. He was a Senior SWE at Bolt and StackAdapt. He graduated from Waterloo & UIUC.
* [Kamal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kamal-nahas/) (CEO) earned a B.S. in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences from UC Berkeley, worked at Apple as a Security/ML software engineer intern, and met hundreds of engineers while working at Human Capital. He grew up in Lebanon, where he led operations resulting in 230+ families fed for an entire month and 25+ civilians housed.
* [Anthony](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anthonyrassi/) (COO) graduated from USC in Computer Engineering and Computer Sciences and worked at Addepar as a software engineer intern. He also grew up in Lebanon, where he won a national hackathon, built a 5-figure affiliate marketing business, and led an engineering team at the country’s largest retailer.

# Our Ask 🙏

1. Sign up at [joinpap.com](http://joinpap.com) (_bonus_: share your feedback with us at [founders@joinpap.com](https://mailto:founders@joinpap.com)).
2. **Share this post and tell your friends about it!** Everyone deserves to earn the money they are entitled to.

launches.tagline: Helping SaaS sales teams close more deals.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Achyuta, Jai, and Bharadwaj!

**TLDR:**

[**Mica**](https://usemica.com/) helps B2B sales teams close more deals by automating their entire sales follow-up process. Our AI agents analyze sales calls, generate tailored collateral, and follow up with prospects until the deal is closed.

**The Problem:**

The best sales reps aren’t just great at selling—they are elite content creators. They crafted tailored collateral like decks, 1-pagers, and product demos to help champions advocate internally. However, creating this content often takes over 30 minutes per call, and with multiple calls a day, even the best reps can only prioritize a few clients, leaving others with subpar follow-ups and millions in lost deals.

**Our Solution:**

Mica automates the sales follow-up process by generating deal-closing collateral in less than a minute. Our AI analyzes sales calls, extracts key insights, builds tailored collateral, and sends this to prospects in a centralized deal summary page.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82748&key=user_uploads/281665/a654eebe-5ef9-48ee-ab9d-ca41efc83bc4)

**Key Benefits**

1. **Quicker Follow-up Time:** Mica creates personalized follow ups in under 1 minute. This lets top performers do A+ work on every deal and helps the rest of the team sell like a top performer.
2. **Faster Sales Cycles:** The point of contact can easily review important information from the call, share it internally, and make decisions faster.

**How it Works**

1. **Upload:** Mica automatically pulls in your sales call from existing recording or notetaking tools.
2. **Extract Key Insights:** Mica identifies the key points the prospect was most interested in.
3. **Generate Tailored Collateral:** Mica creates tailored decks, product demos, and 1-pagers for each key topic.
4. **Share:** Mica generates a shareable link containing all the collateral, which can be sent directly to the prospect in follow-up emails that Mica also creates.

Here’s a demo of Mica that we created from an actual Mica sales call:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xIHwwnYKj5o>

**Our Ask:** We’re looking to onboard customers who want to automate and improve their sales follow-ups.

We’re looking for:

* Sales reps and heads of sales at B2B SaaS companies.
* Founders who are doing founder-led sales.

Anyone who is interested can book a demo [**here**](https://calendly.com/achyutaiyengar/mica-15-minute-demo).

launches.tagline: Make your CX team bionic.
launches.body:
# **Hi YC,**

I’m Gideon, co-founder of [Rulebase](https://rulebase.co/beam). Over the past 3 months, we’ve worked with CX and Ops teams from small 10-seat groups to global BPOs with over 100,000 agents studying how they operate and helping reduce average handle time (AHT) while staying compliant and reducing violations.

# **The problem today**

QA is a lagging indicator.

Level 2 and 3 CX agents manage the most complex issues but are forced to navigate multiple tools, chase missing context, and follow detailed processes from memory, live, under pressure. When mistakes happen, they’re often only caught in post-call QA reviews, long after the damage is done

Today, we’re launching [Beam](https://rulebase.co/beam) the first CX copilot with perfect recall and real-time coaching, built to improve NPS, reduce AHT, and cut down compliance violations.

<https://youtu.be/MaITmAAif4A>

### Let me give you a typical scenario we see all the time:

You’re a fintech or work in a regulated industry. You’ve hired an offshore CX team say 50 agents and 5 QA specialists to make sure all your protocols are being followed and agents are being coached. Now over the last few months:

* AHT has increased leading to you hiring more CX seats.
* Compliance violations are rising from PCI breaches and you are facing more customer complaints.
* Customer authentication has been skipped in some cases, leading to instances of fraud.
* QA can’t manually review every call, and when issues are caught, it’s often days too late to fix them

# **With Beam:**

* Agents get real-time coaching on all protocols and compliance requirements
* Violations are instantly flagged
* Agents have perfect recall, including customer sentiment from past conversations
* QA runs in real time, with auto-generated reports and continuous coaching
* Fraud detection is built-in, blocking bad actors before they get through.

\
If any of the above sounds relevant to your team, we’re offering **YC companies their first 2 months free for up to 50 agents**. This includes full setup, mapping your protocols, and deploying Beam directly into your agent environment.

Interested? Reach out here or book time on my [calendar](https://cal.com/gideonebose/30min), we’ll get you onboarded.
